entries.question_cn: 哪支球队赢得 2026 世界杯冠军？（以 2026-07-19 决赛结果为准，含加时与点球）
entries.question_en: Which team wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup? (Decided by the 2026-07-19 final, including extra time and penalties)
entries.one_liner_cn: 西班牙以约37%居首，阿根廷约24%、法国约14%紧随——Elo前四档断层使西阿法英四队合计约82%；巴西、荷兰因多名主力伤缺被有界下调。
entries.one_liner_en: Spain leads at ~37% with Argentina ~24% and France ~14% — the top-four Elo tier (Spain/Argentina/France/England) combines for ~82%, while Brazil and the Netherlands take bounded downgrades for multiple key injuries.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 断层：西班牙 2157、阿根廷 2115、法国 2063、英格兰 2024 与第五名拉开 30+ 分差距，10 万次蒙特卡洛中四队合计夺冠概率约 82%。
key_reasons.en: Elo stratification: Spain 2157, Argentina 2115, France 2063 and England 2024 sit 30+ points clear of fifth place; the four combine for ~82% of titles across 100k Monte Carlo runs.

key_reasons.cn: 伤病不对称：巴西（内马尔存疑，罗德里戈/米利唐/埃斯特旺缺席）、荷兰（廷贝尔/西蒙斯/德利赫特/斯豪滕缺席）、德国（特尔施特根/格纳布里缺席）遭遇减员潮，而法国、英格兰、哥伦比亚主力齐整——据此做有界上下调。
key_reasons.en: Injury asymmetry: Brazil (Neymar doubtful; Rodrygo/Militao/Estevao out), the Netherlands (Timber/Simons/De Ligt/Schouten out) and Germany (Ter Stegen/Gnabry out) are depleted while France, England and Colombia are near full strength — driving the bounded adjustments.

key_reasons.cn: 新赛制放大强弱差：48 队 104 场、新增 32 强轮，夺冠需连赢 5 轮淘汰赛，Elo 优势逐轮复利，头部球队的边际概率被进一步推高。
key_reasons.en: The new format amplifies strength gaps: with 48 teams, 104 matches and an added round of 32, the champion must win five straight knockout rounds, compounding the Elo edge of the top tier.

entries.method_note: 100k-sim pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, official FIFA 2026 bracket, hosts +100 Elo in group stage only; seed 20260611) + evidence-bounded per-team adjustment (max ±20% relative, max applied ±15%), renormalized to sum 1. Market-blind: no betting or prediction-market inputs of any kind.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 J 组：阿尔及利亚 vs 奥地利（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group J: Algeria vs Austria — 90-minute three-way result?
entries.one_liner_cn: 奥地利凭 Elo 优势小幅领跑，但 Baumgartner 伤退削弱进攻，刚客胜荷兰的阿尔及利亚状态正佳，三路均无把握。
entries.one_liner_en: Austria edge it on Elo, but Baumgartner's injury blunts their attack while Algeria arrive off an away win over the Netherlands — no outcome is near certain.

key_reasons.cn: 奥地利核心攻击手 Baumgartner（赛季 13 个德甲进球）因伤无缘世界杯，进攻端明显减弱。
key_reasons.en: Austria's in-form attacker Baumgartner (13 Bundesliga goals) is ruled out of the World Cup by injury, a clear blow to their attack.

key_reasons.cn: 阿尔及利亚 6 月 3 日客场 1-0 击败荷兰，赛前状态出色；但中场 Boudaoui 伤缺、Bennacer 落选。
key_reasons.en: Algeria beat the Netherlands 1-0 away on Jun 3 — strong form — though Boudaoui is injured and Bennacer was omitted.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 58 分（奥地利 1830 vs 阿尔及利亚 1772），中立场地下统计模型给奥地利约 43% 基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 58-point Elo gap (Austria 1830 vs Algeria 1772) on a neutral venue gives Austria a ~43% baseline win probability in the statistical model.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gave 31.0/25.7/43.3; bounded evidence adjustment of 4pp total (Algeria +1.5, Draw +0.5, Austria -2.0) for Baumgartner's absence vs Algeria's own midfield losses; renormalized. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 and ~±40 Elo sensitivity. No betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 J 组：阿根廷 vs 阿尔及利亚（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group J: Argentina vs Algeria (three-way 90-minute result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 阿根廷 Elo 高出 343 分且近 5 战全胜，模型给约七成胜率；因多名主力带伤及阿尔及利亚刚 1-0 胜荷兰，小幅下调至 69.5%。
entries.one_liner_en: Argentina's 343-point Elo edge and five straight wins put them near 70%; nudged down to 69.5% for squad knocks and Algeria's recent 1-0 win over the Netherlands.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 343 分（阿根廷 2115 vs 阿尔及利亚 1772），Davidson 统计模型基线即给阿根廷约 71% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 343-point Elo gap (Argentina 2115 vs Algeria 1772) gives Argentina about a 71% baseline win probability in the Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 阿根廷近 5 场全胜（进 15 失 1）、梅西近 6 场首发 6 球，但 Balerdi 退队、两右后卫与 Paredes 带伤、门将手指骨折，伤情构成小幅减分。
key_reasons.en: Argentina won their last five (15:1 goals) with Messi scoring in six straight starts, but Balerdi is out and several starters carry knocks — a small downgrade.

key_reasons.cn: 阿尔及利亚 6 月 3 日热身 1-0 击败荷兰，显示对强队的防守组织力；但中场核心 Bennacer 落选名单。
key_reasons.en: Algeria beat the Netherlands 1-0 on June 3, showing defensive organization against elite sides, though midfielder Bennacer was left out of the squad.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gave 71.45/18.63/9.92; bounded evidence adjustment of ~2pp off Argentina for squad injuries and Algeria's Netherlands result, renormalized. Independent of all betting/prediction-market data.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 J 组：阿根廷 vs 奥地利（90 分钟三路赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group J: Argentina vs Austria (three-way result, 90 minutes)
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 差距近 300 分使卫冕冠军阿根廷显著占优；梅西伤情管理与奥地利体系稳定只支持小幅修正。
entries.one_liner_en: A near-300-point Elo gap makes defending champions Argentina clear favourites; Messi's fitness management and Austria's stability justify only a small adjustment.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 285 分（2115 vs 1830），Davidson 统计模型给出阿根廷约 2/3 的基线胜率
key_reasons.en: A 285-point Elo gap (2115 vs 1830) yields a ~2/3 baseline win probability for Argentina in the Davidson model

key_reasons.cn: 梅西 5 月下旬腿筋肌肉过载，Scaloni 确认已恢复训练并将任队长，但 38 岁+腿筋史构成不确定项
key_reasons.en: Messi suffered hamstring muscular overload in late May; Scaloni confirmed he is back training and will captain, but age 38 plus hamstring history is an uncertainty

key_reasons.cn: 奥地利 1998 年以来首进世界杯但 Rangnick 体系成熟，Alaba 伤愈回归任队长，阵容齐整
key_reasons.en: Austria's first World Cup since 1998, but Rangnick's system is mature and a fit David Alaba returns as captain

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Elo snapshot -> Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) -> bounded evidence adjustment (-2pp Argentina, +1pp draw, +1pp Austria; cap ±8pp) -> renormalized. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity and evidence thinness. No betting/prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 D 组：澳大利亚 vs 土耳其，90 分钟赛果？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group D: Australia vs Türkiye — 90-minute result?
entries.one_liner_cn: 土耳其 Elo 高出 134 分、主力齐整且近 8 场 7 胜 1 平，明显占优；澳大利亚锋线减员、主力中卫长伤初愈，土耳其胜约 53.5%。
entries.one_liner_en: Türkiye hold a 134-point Elo edge with a full-strength, in-form squad (7W1D in last 8), while Australia are down a forward and a key defender is fresh off a long injury — Türkiye win around 53.5%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 134 分（土耳其 1911 vs 澳大利亚 1777），Davidson 三路模型在中立场地给土耳其约 51.6% 基础胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 134-point Elo gap (Türkiye 1911 vs Australia 1777) gives Türkiye ~51.6% baseline win probability in the Davidson three-way model at a neutral venue.

key_reasons.cn: 土耳其 26 人名单主力齐整（Çalhanoğlu、Güler、Yıldız、Aktürkoğlu 均入选），且近 8 场 7 胜 1 平状态出色。
key_reasons.en: Türkiye's 26-man squad is at full strength (Çalhanoğlu, Güler, Yıldız, Aktürkoğlu all named) and arrives in strong form with 7W1D in their last 8.

key_reasons.cn: 澳大利亚前锋 D'Agostino 备战营伤退，主力中卫 Souttar 跟腱重伤缺阵近 500 天后刚复出，状态存疑。
key_reasons.en: Australia lost striker D'Agostino to injury in pre-camp, and first-choice centre-back Souttar has only just returned after nearly 500 days out with an Achilles injury.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo -> Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) baseline 23.9/24.6/51.6, then bounded evidence adjustment (~2pp toward Türkiye, cap ±8pp) and renormalization. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity plus evidence thinness. No betting/prediction-market data consulted.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 J 组：奥地利 vs 约旦（2026-06-17）90 分钟赛果？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group J: Austria vs Jordan (2026-06-17) — result after 90 minutes?
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 差 150 分加上约旦近 5 场不胜丢 11 球，奥地利约 55% 占优；但 Baumgartner 伤退令优势打折，约旦爆冷窗口未关死。
entries.one_liner_en: A 150-point Elo gap and Jordan's winless, leaky run give Austria ~55%; Baumgartner's tournament-ending injury trims that edge and keeps Jordan's upset window ajar.

key_reasons.cn: 奥地利核心中场 Baumgartner 髋部肌腱重伤，缺席整届世界杯，进攻组织受损
key_reasons.en: Austria's key midfielder Baumgartner is out of the entire World Cup with a hip tendon injury, denting their creativity

key_reasons.cn: 约旦近 5 场 0 胜并丢 11 球（0-2 哥伦比亚、1-4 瑞士），且主力前锋 Al-Naimat 因 ACL 缺席
key_reasons.en: Jordan are winless in five with 11 goals conceded (0-2 Colombia, 1-4 Switzerland) and first-choice striker Al-Naimat is out with an ACL injury

key_reasons.cn: Elo 1830 vs 1680（150 分差距），中立场 Davidson 模型给出奥地利 53.3% 的统计基线
key_reasons.en: Elo 1830 vs 1680 (a 150-point gap) yields a 53.3% statistical baseline for Austria from the neutral-venue Davidson model

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue) -> p_stat 0.533/0.242/0.225; bounded sourced adjustment (net ~2pp toward Austria, cap +/-8pp) -> p_final 0.55/0.24/0.21. No betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 G 组：比利时 vs 埃及（90 分钟三路赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group G: Belgium vs Egypt (90-minute three-way result)
entries.one_liner_cn: 比利时实力与状态占优，但埃及全主力且防守纪律严明，平局风险不低，比利时胜率约 57%。
entries.one_liner_en: Belgium are stronger and in better form, but a full-strength, well-drilled Egypt keeps draw risk meaningful; Belgium win at about 57%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 198 分（1894 vs 1696），中性场地下 Davidson 模型给比利时约 58% 基础胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 198-point Elo gap (1894 vs 1696) gives Belgium roughly a 58% base win probability on neutral ground under the Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 比利时近五场 4 胜 1 平（5-0 突尼斯、2-0 克罗地亚），德布劳内健康并预计首发，状态明显占优。
key_reasons.en: Belgium are W4 D1 in their last five (5-0 Tunisia, 2-0 Croatia) and De Bruyne is fit and expected to start, a clear form edge.

key_reasons.cn: 埃及全主力出战（萨拉赫任队长、马尔穆什在列）且打法务实密集，利于拖平；比利时卢卡库缺乏比赛状态。
key_reasons.en: Egypt are at full strength (Salah captains, Marmoush included) with a compact pragmatic setup that favours the draw, while Belgium's Lukaku lacks match fitness.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net) Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) -> p_stat BEL 58.3 / Draw 23.1 / EGY 18.6; bounded evidence-based adjustment of ~3.9pp (cap 8pp) toward the draw for Egypt's full-strength defensive block and Belgium's forward-line fitness doubts -> p_final 57/25/18. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity and evidence thinness. No market or odds inputs of any kind.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 G 组：比利时 vs 伊朗（90 分钟赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group G: Belgium vs IR Iran (90-minute result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 比利时 Elo 高出 122 分、纸面占优，但双核带伤与伊朗的韧性让这场更像六成把握而非碾压局。
entries.one_liner_en: Belgium's 122-point Elo edge makes them clear favourites on paper, but star fitness doubts and Iran's resilience keep this a 60-40 type game rather than a blowout.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 122 分（比利时 1894/第15 vs 伊朗 1772/第29），中立场统计模型给比利时约 50% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: 122-point Elo gap (Belgium 1894/15th vs Iran 1772/29th); the neutral-venue statistical model gives Belgium about 50%.

key_reasons.cn: 伊朗将阿兹蒙整队除名，91 场 57 球的二号射手空缺，进攻端实质降级。
key_reasons.en: Iran omitted Azmoun entirely, leaving a 57-goals-in-91-caps void and a material attacking downgrade.

key_reasons.cn: 德布劳内（眼伤）与卢卡库（髋伤、全季仅 7 场）带伤入选，比利时进攻核心状态存疑。
key_reasons.en: De Bruyne (eye injury) and Lukaku (hip, only 7 club matches all season) were named while injured, leaving Belgium's attacking core's fitness in doubt.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 50.3/24.8/24.9, plus bounded evidence-based adjustment (net +1.5pp Belgium, -1.0pp Iran, -0.5pp draw), renormalized. No betting/prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯 B 组：波黑 vs 卡塔尔（90 分钟赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group B: Bosnia-Herzegovina vs Qatar (90-minute result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 差 174 分让波黑明显占优，但哲科伤情与末轮变数限制把握度，波黑胜率约 54%。
entries.one_liner_en: A 174-point Elo gap makes Bosnia-Herzegovina the clear stronger side, but Dzeko's injury doubt and final-matchday variables cap conviction at about a 54% win probability.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 实力差明显：波黑 1595（第 65）对卡塔尔 1421（第 96），Davidson 模型基准给波黑约 56% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: Clear Elo gap: BIH 1595 (No. 65) vs Qatar 1421 (No. 96); the Davidson baseline gives BIH about a 56% win probability.

key_reasons.cn: 波黑核心哲科肩伤后仅累计出场 64 分钟并缺席最后热身赛，锋线还有 Tabakovic、Sunjic 伤情，下调波黑 2pp。
key_reasons.en: BIH talisman Dzeko has only 64 minutes since his shoulder injury and missed the final warm-up, with Tabakovic and Sunjic also doubts — BIH shaded down 2pp.

key_reasons.cn: 卡塔尔在洛佩特吉手下仅 2 胜、自 2025 年 12 月后无正式比赛且热身负爱尔兰，低迷状态已反映在低 Elo 中。
key_reasons.en: Qatar have just 2 wins under Lopetegui, no competitive match since December 2025 and a friendly loss to Ireland; this poor form is already reflected in their low Elo.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) on eloratings.net 2026-06-11 snapshot gives 55.8/23.7/20.5; bounded sourced adjustment of 2pp (BIH -2, Draw +1, Qatar +1) for BIH striker fitness doubts; no betting or prediction-market inputs used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 C 组：巴西 vs 海地（90 分钟三路赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group C: Brazil vs Haiti (three-way 90-minute result)
entries.one_liner_cn: 巴西与海地 Elo 差距高达 443 分，即便内马尔伤情存疑，巴西仍以约 76% 概率强势领跑，海地爆冷空间很小。
entries.one_liner_en: With a 443-point Elo gap over Haiti, Brazil are strong favourites at roughly 76% even with Neymar's fitness in doubt; an upset has little room.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 443 分（巴西 1991 vs 海地 1548），Davidson 三路模型给出巴西约 78.5% 基础胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 443-point Elo gap (Brazil 1991 vs Haiti 1548) yields a ~78.5% base win probability for Brazil in the Davidson three-way model.

key_reasons.cn: 内马尔二级小腿拉伤、出战成疑，但巴西阵容深度（维尼修斯、拉菲尼亚等）足以覆盖，仅构成小幅不确定性。
key_reasons.en: Neymar's grade-two calf strain leaves him doubtful, but Brazil's depth (Vinicius Jr, Raphinha, etc.) covers it, adding only modest uncertainty.

key_reasons.cn: 海地新增英超即战力（伊西多尔 3 月改披海地战袍、贝勒加德入选），且预期对巴西摆低位防守，Elo 可能略微低估其防守韧性。
key_reasons.en: Haiti added Premier League talent (Isidor switched allegiance in March; Bellegarde in squad) and is expected to defend deep vs Brazil, so Elo may slightly understate their resilience.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo -> Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) -> bounded evidence adjustment (-2pp Brazil, +1.5pp draw, +0.5pp Haiti; cap +/-8pp) -> renormalized. No betting/prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 C 组：巴西 vs 摩洛哥（90 分钟赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group C: Brazil vs Morocco (90-minute result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 巴西实力与状态占优、摩洛哥赛前 48 小时连折两将，巴西约 58% 胜率看好，但平局与冷门不可忽视。
entries.one_liner_en: Brazil hold the Elo and form edge while Morocco lost two squad players within 48 hours of kickoff; Brazil favoured at ~58%, with the draw and upset still live.

key_reasons.cn: 摩洛哥开球前 48 小时内连失主力中卫 Aguerd 与边锋 Ezzalzouli（均伤退换人）
key_reasons.en: Morocco lost starting centre-back Aguerd and winger Ezzalzouli to injury within 48 hours of kickoff

key_reasons.cn: 中立场地下 164 分的 Elo 差（巴西 1991 vs 摩洛哥 1827）给出巴西明显统计优势
key_reasons.en: A 164-point Elo gap (Brazil 1991 vs Morocco 1827) at a neutral venue gives Brazil a clear statistical edge

key_reasons.cn: 巴西虽缺 Neymar（小腿伤）及 Militão/Rodrygo，但 4-3-3 主力框架已定且热身两连胜
key_reasons.en: Brazil miss Neymar (calf) plus Militao/Rodrygo, but the settled 4-3-3 won both warm-up matches

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) on eloratings.net ratings; bounded evidence adjustment of +3pp to Brazil (cap ±8pp) for Morocco's late injury withdrawals, partially offset by Brazil's own absences; renormalized. No betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 B 组：加拿大 vs 波黑（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group B: Canada vs Bosnia-Herzegovina (three-way result after 90 minutes)?
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 差约 193 分加主场之利让加拿大明显占优，但 Davies 缺席揭幕战，胜率下修至六成出头。
entries.one_liner_en: A ~193-point Elo gap plus home advantage favors Canada, but with Davies out of the opener the win probability is revised down to the low 60s.

key_reasons.cn: 加拿大队长 Davies（左腿筋伤）预计缺席揭幕战，Marsch 称力争第 2/3 场复出，主队失去最强攻击点。
key_reasons.en: Canada captain Alphonso Davies (left hamstring) is expected to miss the opener; Marsch hopes he returns for group match 2 or 3, costing the hosts their biggest attacking threat.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 实力差显著：加拿大 1788（第 25）对波黑 1595（第 65），且加拿大作为东道主在多伦多主场作战（+100 修正）。
key_reasons.en: Large Elo gap: Canada 1788 (rank 25) vs Bosnia 1595 (rank 65), with Canada playing at home in Toronto as a host nation (+100 adjustment).

key_reasons.cn: 波黑热身赛进攻乏力（0-0 北马其顿、1-1 巴拿马），锋线依赖 40 岁的 Dzeko。
key_reasons.en: Bosnia's attack looked blunt in warm-ups (0-0 vs North Macedonia, 1-1 vs Panama), relying on 40-year-old Edin Dzeko up front.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯 B 组小组赛：加拿大 vs 卡塔尔（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group B: Canada vs Qatar (90-minute three-way result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 加拿大坐镇温哥华主场、Elo 优势近 470 分，尽管伤病困扰仍是大概率取胜一方；卡塔尔状态低迷，爆冷空间有限。
entries.one_liner_en: Hosting in Vancouver with a near-470-point Elo edge, Canada are heavy favourites despite injury concerns; out-of-form Qatar have limited upset room.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距巨大：加拿大 1788（世界第 25）+100 主场加成 vs 卡塔尔 1421（世界第 96），统计基线给加拿大约 80% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: Huge Elo gap: Canada 1788 (world #25) plus a +100 host bonus vs Qatar 1421 (world #96); the statistical baseline gives Canada about 80%.

key_reasons.cn: 加拿大伤病疑云：Davies（腿筋）缺席首战、6/18 出场存疑，主力中卫 Bombito 据报离队，David 状态平平——小幅下调加拿大胜率。
key_reasons.en: Canadian injury cloud: Davies (hamstring) misses the opener and is doubtful for June 18, starting CB Bombito reportedly off the roster, David below form - a small trim to Canada's win probability.

key_reasons.cn: 卡塔尔在 Lopetegui 治下 2025 夏以来仅 2 胜、世预赛勉强过关，自身状态不足以支撑更大的爆冷调整。
key_reasons.en: Qatar have only 2 wins under Lopetegui since summer 2025 and scraped through qualifying - their own form does not support a larger upset adjustment.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, +100 host bonus for Canada group match) -> p_stat 0.800/0.146/0.054; bounded evidence adjustment (Canada -3pp, draw +2pp, Qatar +1pp, within the +/-8pp cap) -> p_final. No betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 K 组：刚果民主共和国 vs 乌兹别克斯坦（90 分钟三路赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group K: DR Congo vs Uzbekistan (three-way result after 90 minutes)
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 高 62 分、热身状态更稳的乌兹别克斯坦小幅占优，但坐拥英超班底的刚果（金）完全有能力翻盘，三个方向都真实存在。
entries.one_liner_en: Uzbekistan, 62 Elo points stronger and in steadier warm-up form, hold a modest edge, but DR Congo's Premier League core keeps all three outcomes genuinely live.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 62 分（乌兹别克斯坦 1714 第 42 vs 刚果（金）1652 第 55），统计基准温和偏向乌兹别克斯坦（约 44% 对 31%）。
key_reasons.en: A 62-point Elo gap (Uzbekistan 1714, rank 42 vs DR Congo 1652, rank 55) makes the statistical baseline mildly favour Uzbekistan (~44% vs 31%).

key_reasons.cn: 乌兹别克斯坦在 Cannavaro 带领下热身连胜科威特、埃及，临赛仅 0-1 小负荷兰，曼城中卫 Khusanov 领衔防线。
key_reasons.en: Under Cannavaro, Uzbekistan beat Kuwait and Egypt in warm-ups and lost only 0-1 to the Netherlands on the eve of the tournament, with Man City's Khusanov anchoring the defence.

key_reasons.cn: 刚果（金）拥有 Wan-Bissaka、Wissa 等英超球员、阵容估值约 1.43 亿欧元，但最后热身 1-2 负智利且因埃博拉疫情顾虑空场进行，备战受扰。
key_reasons.en: DR Congo field Premier League players like Wan-Bissaka and Wissa with a ~EUR 143m squad, but lost their final warm-up 1-2 to Chile, played behind closed doors over Ebola-related health concerns.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gave 0.306/0.256/0.438; a bounded +0.4pp/+0.4pp/-0.8pp evidence adjustment (DR Congo's higher-valued European core vs Uzbekistan's better warm-up form and DR Congo's disrupted preparation, largely offsetting) yields 0.31/0.26/0.43. No betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 B 组：瑞士 vs 波黑（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group B: Switzerland vs Bosnia-Herzegovina (90-minute three-way result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 瑞士 Elo 高出近 300 分、实力明显占优，看好其取胜；但波黑防守顽强且瑞士近期对中游球队连续战平，平局风险不可忽视。
entries.one_liner_en: Switzerland's near-300-point Elo edge makes them clear favourites, but Bosnia's stubborn defence and Switzerland's recent draws against mid-tier sides keep the draw risk material.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 296 分（瑞士 1891 vs 波黑 1595），中立场地 Davidson 模型给瑞士约 67.5% 基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 296-point Elo gap (Switzerland 1891 vs Bosnia 1595) yields a ~67.5% baseline Swiss win probability in the neutral-venue Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 波黑近 5 场 1 胜 3 平 1 负、6 月 6 日 1-1 平巴拿马，状态平平但附加赛曾淘汰意大利，防守韧性强。
key_reasons.en: Bosnia are 1W-3D-1L in their last five (1-1 vs Panama on Jun 6) — patchy form, but they eliminated Italy in the playoffs with a resilient defensive setup.

key_reasons.cn: 瑞士近期对中游球队连续战平（3 月 0-0 挪威、6 月 6 日 1-1 澳大利亚），破密集防守效率存疑，故小幅上调平局概率。
key_reasons.en: Switzerland recently drew twice against mid-tier sides (0-0 Norway in March, 1-1 Australia on Jun 6), raising doubts about breaking down compact blocks — hence a small upward draw adjustment.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net 2026-06-11) -> three-way Davidson (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 67.5/20.2/12.3 -> bounded evidence adjustment (CHE -2.5pp, draw +2.3pp, BIH +0.2pp, within ±8pp cap) -> renormalized p_final 65.0/22.5/12.5. No betting or prediction-market data consulted.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯 B 组：瑞士 vs 加拿大（2026-06-24，温哥华）90 分钟赛果？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group B: Switzerland vs Canada (2026-06-24, Vancouver) — 90-minute result?
entries.one_liner_cn: 瑞士阵容齐整小幅占优，但加拿大坐拥温哥华主场，三路概率接近，势均力敌的小组头名之争。
entries.one_liner_en: Switzerland edge it on squad health and form, but Canada's Vancouver home advantage keeps this a near coin-flip for top spot in Group B.

key_reasons.cn: 加拿大伤病潮：主力中卫 Bombito 据报被移出名单，Flores 伤退由 Nelson 替补，Koné 训练中发烧离场。
key_reasons.en: Canada's injury wave: starting CB Bombito reportedly removed from the roster, Flores withdrew injured (Nelson called up), Kone left training with a fever.

key_reasons.cn: Davies 自 2025-03 ACL 撕裂后又两度腿筋受伤，出场存疑，但 6/10 已重返合练，距本场尚有约两周窗口。
key_reasons.en: Davies, after a March 2025 ACL tear and two hamstring setbacks, is a fitness doubt but returned to group training June 10, with about two weeks before this fixture.

key_reasons.cn: 瑞士 5/20 公布名单无重大伤病，Xhaka（145 次出场）领衔老将轴心，5/31 友谊赛 4-1 胜约旦，备战平稳。
key_reasons.en: Switzerland named a healthy 26-man squad May 20, led by Xhaka (145 caps), and warmed up with a 4-1 friendly win over Jordan on May 31.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7; +100 host bonus for Canada group match) gives 37.4/25.9/36.7; evidence-bounded adjustment +3.0/+0.5/-3.5pp (cap 8pp) for Canada injuries vs healthy Swiss squad; renormalized. No betting-market inputs of any kind.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 E 组：科特迪瓦 vs 厄瓜多尔（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group E: Cote d'Ivoire vs Ecuador (three-way result, 90 minutes)?
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 差 243 分使厄瓜多尔明显占优，但科特迪瓦状态火热、两队均防守见长，揭幕战平局概率高于纯模型值。
entries.one_liner_en: A 243-point Elo gap makes Ecuador the clear favourite, but Cote d'Ivoire's hot form and two defence-first sides lift the draw above the pure model value.

key_reasons.cn: 厄瓜多尔 Elo 1938（第 9）远高于科特迪瓦 1695（第 49），世预赛南美区第 2 且 18 轮仅失 5 球。
key_reasons.en: Ecuador's Elo of 1938 (rank 9) towers over Cote d'Ivoire's 1695 (rank 49); 2nd in CONMEBOL qualifying with only 5 goals conceded in 18 games.

key_reasons.cn: 科特迪瓦近期热身赛 2-1 胜法国、4-0 胜韩国、1-0 胜苏格兰，状态火热但已大体反映在 Elo 中。
key_reasons.en: Cote d'Ivoire beat France 2-1 (Jun 4), South Korea 4-0 and Scotland 1-0 in warm-ups — hot form, though largely reflected in Elo already.

key_reasons.cn: 厄瓜多尔无重大伤停：仅替补前锋 Campana 因伤落选，Caicedo 热身赛轮休属保护性安排。
key_reasons.en: No major Ecuador absences: only backup striker Campana missed out injured; Caicedo's friendly rest was precautionary.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 K 组：哥伦比亚 vs 刚果民主共和国（90 分钟三路赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group K: Colombia vs DR Congo (three-way result after 90 minutes)
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 差 330 分、状态火热且阵容齐整的哥伦比亚是明确强方，世界杯首秀的刚果（金）爆冷需要超常发挥。
entries.one_liner_en: With a 330-point Elo gap, hot form and a fully fit squad, Colombia are the clear stronger side; an upset by debutants DR Congo would require an exceptional performance.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 330 分（哥伦比亚 1982 第 7 vs 刚果（金）1652 第 55），统计基准强烈倾向哥伦比亚。
key_reasons.en: A 330-point Elo gap (Colombia 1982, rank 7 vs DR Congo 1652, rank 55) makes the statistical baseline strongly favour Colombia.

key_reasons.cn: 哥伦比亚 26 人名单核心齐整、无伤病减员，曾 28 场不败并打进 2024 美洲杯决赛。
key_reasons.en: Colombia's 26-man squad is at full strength with no injury absences, after a 28-match unbeaten run and the 2024 Copa America final.

key_reasons.cn: 刚果（金）1974 年后首次参赛、全队均为世界杯首秀，主力前锋 Wissa 上赛季伤病缠身状态起伏。
key_reasons.en: DR Congo are at their first finals since 1974 with an all-debutant squad, and lead striker Wissa is coming off an injury-hit, inconsistent season.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gave 0.704/0.191/0.105; a bounded +2pp/-1pp/-1pp evidence adjustment (full-strength Colombia vs all-debutant DR Congo with striker form concerns) yields 0.72/0.18/0.10. No betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯 K 组小组赛（2026-06-27）：哥伦比亚 vs 葡萄牙，90 分钟三路赛果？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group K (2026-06-27): Colombia vs Portugal, three-way result after 90 minutes?
entries.one_liner_cn: 两队 Elo 仅差 7 分、实力几乎完全对等，这场 K 组收官战大概率是争头名之战，三路概率高度接近，葡萄牙仅以毫厘领先。
entries.one_liner_en: Only 7 Elo points separate the sides; this likely Group K top-spot decider is a near coin-flip across all three outcomes, with Portugal ahead by a hair.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 几乎持平：哥伦比亚 1982（第 7）vs 葡萄牙 1989（第 6），中立场 Davidson 模型给出 36.3/25.9/37.8 的基准三路概率。
key_reasons.en: Near-identical Elo: Colombia 1982 (7th) vs Portugal 1989 (6th); the neutral-venue Davidson model yields a 36.3/25.9/37.8 baseline.

key_reasons.cn: 末轮大概率为争头名之战，双方或均已出线，轮换与求稳情形小幅抬升平局概率。
key_reasons.en: Likely a final-matchday top-spot decider with both sides possibly already qualified, nudging draw likelihood up via rotation and risk aversion.

key_reasons.cn: 状态信号略偏哥伦比亚：哥伦比亚 2-0 完胜约旦收官，葡萄牙两场热身均一球小胜且 C罗连续 5 场未进球。
key_reasons.en: Form signal slightly favors Colombia: a clean 2-0 over Jordan versus two narrow one-goal Portugal wins and Ronaldo five internationals without scoring.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) on eloratings.net ratings, plus a bounded sourced adjustment (~2pp total, cap 8pp), renormalized. No betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 H 组：佛得角 vs 沙特阿拉伯，90 分钟三路赛果？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group H: Cabo Verde vs Saudi Arabia, three-way 90-minute result?
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 仅差 2 分的五五开对决：沙特凭世界杯经验略占上风，佛得角首秀且阵容老化，平局概率亦不容忽视。
entries.one_liner_en: A coin-flip with just 2 Elo points between them: Saudi Arabia edges it on World Cup experience over aging debutants Cabo Verde, with the draw far from negligible.

key_reasons.cn: 两队 Elo 几乎完全持平（佛得角 1578 第 68 / 沙特 1576 第 69），统计模型接近抛硬币。
key_reasons.en: Near-identical Elo ratings (Cabo Verde 1578, rank 68 vs Saudi Arabia 1576, rank 69) make the statistical baseline close to a coin flip.

key_reasons.cn: 沙特 4 月 17 日临阵换帅，Donis 仅率队 3 场（1 胜 1 平 1 负），磨合风险限制其经验优势。
key_reasons.en: Saudi Arabia sacked Renard on April 17; new coach Donis has only 3 matches in charge (1W 1D 1L), a cohesion risk that caps their experience edge.

key_reasons.cn: 佛得角历史首秀且主力脊柱老化（Vozinha 40、Stopira 38、Mendes 36），沙特则保留 2022 击败阿根廷的经验班底，故小幅向沙特修正 1pp。
key_reasons.en: Debutants Cabo Verde carry an aging spine (Vozinha 40, Stopira 38, Mendes 36) while Saudi Arabia retains its experienced 2022 core, justifying a small 1pp shift toward Saudi Arabia.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gives p_stat A 37.25% / draw 25.93% / B 36.82%; a bounded 1pp evidence adjustment (Saudi tournament experience vs Cabo Verde debut + aging core, offset by Saudi coaching upheaval) yields p_final. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity and thin evidence. No market/odds inputs of any kind.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 A 组：捷克 vs 墨西哥（2026-06-24，90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 FIFA World Cup Group A: Czechia vs Mexico (2026-06-24, 90-minute three-way result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 坐镇阿兹特克、2026 年 8 场不败的墨西哥实力与主场双重占优，捷克爆冷空间有限，墨西哥胜约 64%。
entries.one_liner_en: At the Azteca and unbeaten in eight 2026 matches, Mexico hold a double edge in strength and home advantage; Mexico to win at roughly 64%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距明显：墨西哥 1875（#18）对捷克 1740（#35），且东道主小组赛主场再加成。
key_reasons.en: Clear Elo gap: Mexico 1875 (#18) vs Czechia 1740 (#35), with a host-nation home bonus on top for the group stage.

key_reasons.cn: 墨西哥 2026 年 8 场不败：逼平比利时、葡萄牙，热身赛 1-0 澳大利亚、5-1 塞尔维亚。
key_reasons.en: Mexico unbeaten in eight matches in 2026, including draws with Belgium and Portugal and tune-up wins of 1-0 over Australia and 5-1 over Serbia.

key_reasons.cn: 比赛在墨西哥城阿兹特克体育场（约 8.3 万观众、海拔约 2,240 米），对欧洲客队体能消耗大。
key_reasons.en: Played at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City (~83,000 fans, ~2,240 m altitude), physically taxing for European visitors.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net) -> Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, host +100 for Mexico home group match) gives p_stat 16.0/22.1/61.9; bounded evidence adjustment of ~4pp (Mexico form, Azteca altitude, Hlozek fitness) renormalized to p_final 14.5/21.5/64.0. entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 A 组：捷克 vs 南非（90 分钟三路赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group A: Czechia vs South Africa (90-minute three-way result)
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 差 223 分让捷克明显占优，但切尔尼伤缺与南非的阵容磨合让比赛仍有变数，捷克胜率约六成。
entries.one_liner_en: A 223-point Elo gap makes Czechia clear favourites, but Cerny's injury and South Africa's cohesion keep the Czech win probability around 60%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 评分捷克 1740（第 35）对南非 1517（第 80），差距 223 分，统计基线明显倾向捷克。
key_reasons.en: Elo ratings: Czechia 1740 (rank 35) vs South Africa 1517 (rank 80), a 223-point gap that tilts the statistical baseline clearly toward Czechia.

key_reasons.cn: 捷克头号创造者切尔尼因伤缺席整届世界杯，进攻创造力受损，是小幅下调捷克胜率的主因。
key_reasons.en: Czechia's most influential creator Vaclav Cerny misses the entire tournament through injury, the main reason for a small downgrade of the Czech win probability.

key_reasons.cn: 南非 26 人名单延续预选赛班底，19 人来自国内联赛、配合成熟，但旅欧球员仅 5 人，上限有限。
key_reasons.en: South Africa's 26-man squad keeps the qualifying core: 19 domestic-based players form a cohesive unit, though only five are based in Europe, capping the ceiling.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gives p_stat 60.8/22.4/16.8; bounded evidence adjustment of -2pp Czechia (+1pp draw, +1pp South Africa) for the Cerny injury and South Africa's squad cohesion, capped at +/-8pp. No market data used anywhere.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 E 组：厄瓜多尔 vs 德国（2026-06-25），90 分钟三路赛果？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group E: Ecuador vs Germany (2026-06-25), three-way result after 90 minutes?

entries.one_liner_en: Elo virtually level (1938 vs 1932); Ecuador's form and defense edge a Germany side carrying knocks - near coin-flip, slight tilt to Ecuador.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 仅差 6 分：厄瓜多尔 1938（世界第 9）vs 德国 1932（世界第 10），中立场地无东道主加成。
key_reasons.en: Only 6 Elo points apart: Ecuador 1938 (world #9) vs Germany 1932 (world #10), neutral venue with no host bonus.

key_reasons.cn: 厄瓜多尔 19 场不败，热身 3-0 危地马拉、2-1 沙特（后者就在本场场地新泽西），预选赛 18 轮仅失 5 球。
key_reasons.en: Ecuador unbeaten in 19, warm-up wins 3-0 vs Guatemala and 2-1 vs Saudi Arabia (the latter at this match's New Jersey venue), and only 5 goals conceded in 18 qualifiers.

key_reasons.cn: 德国伤情存疑：诺伊尔小腿伤缺席全部热身赛、穆夏拉骨折后仍在找状态、格纳布里反复、卡尔伤退。
key_reasons.en: Germany carries fitness doubts: Neuer (calf) missed both friendlies, Musiala still building rhythm after a broken leg, Gnabry had a setback, Karl withdrew injured.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue) gives 37.7/25.9/36.4; bounded evidence adjustment of +1.5/+1.0/-2.5pp (cap 8pp) for Ecuador form+fitness vs Germany injury doubts; renormalized. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity plus 14-days-out evidence uncertainty.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 E 组：厄瓜多尔 vs 库拉索（90 分钟三路赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group E: Ecuador vs Curaçao (three-way 90-minute result)
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 差 504 分的悬殊对决：厄瓜多尔全主力且状态火热，库拉索赛前两度换帅，厄瓜多尔约 84% 取胜，悬念在比分而非胜负。
entries.one_liner_en: A 504-point Elo mismatch: full-strength, in-form Ecuador against a Curaçao side rattled by two pre-tournament coaching changes — roughly 84% for Ecuador, with the margin the real question.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo -> Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 0.161/0.221/0.618; bounded evidence adjustment (Scotland -4.0pp, Haiti +2.5pp, Draw +1.5pp; sums to zero) -> p_final 0.185/0.235/0.580. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity and evidence thinness. entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 L 组：克罗地亚 vs 加纳（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group L: Croatia vs Ghana (90-minute three-way result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 差距 402 分叠加加纳核心库杜斯伤缺，克罗地亚明显占优；变数在于第三轮可能的轮换与动力下降。
entries.one_liner_en: A 402-point Elo gap plus Ghana losing Kudus makes Croatia the clear favourite; matchday-3 rotation is the main wildcard.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 积分差 402 分（克罗地亚 1912 / 第 12 vs 加纳 1510 / 第 81），统计模型给出克罗地亚约 76% 基线胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 402-point Elo gap (Croatia 1912 / 12th vs Ghana 1510 / 81st) yields a ~76% baseline win probability for Croatia.

key_reasons.cn: 加纳头号球星库杜斯因大腿长期伤势无缘世界杯，主力中卫萨利苏（ACL）与吉库也缺席，攻防核心同时受损。
key_reasons.en: Ghana's star Mohammed Kudus is out with a long-term thigh injury, and first-choice centre-backs Salisu (ACL) and Djiku are also missing.

key_reasons.cn: 本场为 L 组第三轮，克罗地亚若已提前出线存在轮换与动力下降风险；莫德里奇 40 岁、科瓦契奇跟腱伤后状态待察。
key_reasons.en: As Group L matchday 3, Croatia may rotate if already qualified; Modric is 40 and Kovacic is returning from Achilles problems.

entries.method_note: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus): p_stat Croatia 75.8% / Draw 16.7% / Ghana 7.5%; bounded evidence adjustment ~3pp (Ghana injuries vs Croatia rotation risk) -> p_final. Market-blind: no betting or prediction-market inputs.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 G 组：伊朗 vs 新西兰，90 分钟三路赛果？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group G: IR Iran vs New Zealand, three-way 90-minute result?
entries.one_liner_cn: 伊朗实力、经验与阵容稳定性全面占优，约六成胜率；新西兰高度依赖刚伤愈的 Chris Wood，爆冷空间有限但平局风险不可忽视。
entries.one_liner_en: Iran are clearly superior in quality, experience and squad continuity (~60% win probability); New Zealand lean heavily on a just-recovered Chris Wood — upset room is limited, but the draw risk is real.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 210 分（伊朗 1772 vs 新西兰 1562），Davidson 统计基线即给伊朗约 59% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 210-point Elo gap (Iran 1772 vs New Zealand 1562) puts the Davidson statistical baseline at ~59% for Iran.

key_reasons.cn: 新西兰头号射手 Chris Wood 整季受伤病困扰，4 月才复出，热身赛对英格兰 78 分钟已是 2024 年 11 月以来最多，状态存疑。
key_reasons.en: New Zealand's top scorer Chris Wood had an injury-disrupted season, only returning in April; 78 minutes vs England in the final warm-up was his most since November 2024.

key_reasons.cn: 伊朗 6 月 1 日最终名单核心齐整（Taremi 领衔、连续第三届世界杯），但 Azmoun 被排除，锋线深度略减。
key_reasons.en: Iran's June 1 final squad keeps a settled core (Taremi leading, third straight World Cup) but omits Azmoun, slightly trimming attacking depth.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, no host bonus — neutral venue) gives p_stat 59.5/22.8/17.8; bounded evidence adjustment (~5pp total, cap ±8pp, net +2.5pp Iran) yields p_final 62/22/16. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6–0.8 sensitivity plus evidence thinness. No betting/odds/market data consulted.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 I 组：伊拉克 vs 挪威（90 分钟赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 FIFA World Cup Group I: Iraq vs Norway (90-minute result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 挪威凭哈兰德火力与 307 分 Elo 差距占约三分之二胜算，但伊拉克刚逼平西班牙，低位防守让平局有现实可能。
entries.one_liner_en: Norway are ~two-thirds favourites on Haaland's firepower and a 307-point Elo gap, but Iraq just held Spain and their low block gives the draw real upside.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 307 分（挪威 1914 vs 伊拉克 1607），Davidson 模型基线给挪威约 68.5% 胜算。
key_reasons.en: 307-point Elo gap (Norway 1914 vs Iraq 1607); the Davidson baseline gives Norway ~68.5%.

key_reasons.cn: 哈兰德欧洲区预选赛 16 球、46 场 50 个国家队进球史上最快，挪威攻击力顶级。
key_reasons.en: Haaland scored 16 in European qualifying and reached 50 international goals in a record 46 caps — elite firepower.

key_reasons.cn: 伊拉克 6 月 4 日 1-1 逼平 Elo 第 1 的西班牙，低位防守体系成色十足，支撑小幅上调平局与冷门概率。
key_reasons.en: Iraq held Elo #1 Spain 1-1 on Jun 4, validating their low block and a small upward shift for the draw/upset.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue) p_stat 11.7/19.8/68.5 + bounded evidence adjustment (+1.3/+1.2/-2.5 pp, cap ±8pp), renormalized. No market inputs of any kind.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 J 组：约旦 vs 阿尔及利亚（2026-06-22，90 分钟赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group J: Jordan vs Algeria (2026-06-22, 90-minute result)
entries.one_liner_cn: 阿尔及利亚 Elo 高出 92 分且阵容齐整，约旦热身连败加锋线伤员，阿胜概率约 49%，但非压倒性优势。
entries.one_liner_en: Algeria's 92-point Elo edge and intact squad against Jordan's warm-up slump put Algeria near 49% — a clear but not overwhelming favourite.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 92 分（阿尔及利亚 1772 / 第 29 vs 约旦 1680 / 第 52），统计模型给出阿队约 47% 基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: 92-point Elo gap (Algeria 1772 / rank 29 vs Jordan 1680 / rank 52) yields a ~47% baseline Algeria win probability.

key_reasons.cn: 约旦热身赛 1-4 负瑞士、0-2 负哥伦比亚，前锋 Sabra 踝伤退队，由 20 岁后卫 Taha 顶替。
key_reasons.en: Jordan lost warm-ups 1-4 to Switzerland and 0-2 to Colombia; forward Sabra withdrew with an ankle injury, replaced by 20-year-old defender Taha.

key_reasons.cn: 阿尔及利亚名单齐整：Mahrez 领衔（113 场 38 球），Amoura 预选赛 8 场 10 球，攻击力有据可查。
key_reasons.en: Algeria's squad is intact: Mahrez leads (113 caps, 38 goals) and Amoura scored 10 in 8 qualifiers — documented attacking strength.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, no host bonus; p_stat 27.7/25.3/47.0) plus bounded evidence adjustment (total ~4pp <= 8pp cap), renormalized. Independent of all betting/prediction-market data.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 J 组：约旦 vs 阿根廷（90 分钟三路赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group J: Jordan vs Argentina (90-minute three-way result)
entries.one_liner_cn: 435 分 Elo 差距令卫冕冠军阿根廷占绝对优势，但末轮轮换动机与梅西腿筋隐忧给约旦留下小幅逼平空间。
entries.one_liner_en: A 435-point Elo gap makes defending champions Argentina overwhelming favourites, though Matchday-3 rotation incentives and Messi's hamstring concern leave Jordan a modest draw window.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距巨大：阿根廷 2115（世界第 2）对约旦 1680（第 52），Davidson 模型基线给阿根廷 78% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: Huge Elo gap: Argentina 2115 (rank 2) vs Jordan 1680 (rank 52); the Davidson baseline gives Argentina 78%.

key_reasons.cn: 末轮轮换风险：阿根廷先打阿尔及利亚与奥地利，大概率提前出线，第 3 轮主力轮换概率不低。
key_reasons.en: Matchday-3 rotation risk: Argentina face Algeria and Austria first and will likely have qualification settled, making rotation plausible.

key_reasons.cn: 梅西 5 月 25 日左腿筋“肌肉过载”，斯卡洛尼称恢复顺利但 38 岁高龄下末轮出场时间存疑。
key_reasons.en: Messi suffered a left-hamstring 'muscular overload' on May 25; Scaloni says recovery is on track, but his Matchday-3 minutes at 38 are uncertain.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo (fetched 2026-06-11) through a Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gives p_stat Jordan 6.4% / Draw 15.6% / Argentina 78.0%; bounded evidence adjustment of 6pp total (cap 8pp) for rotation incentive, Messi/fringe injuries, Jordan motivation and indoor venue yields p_final. entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 F 组：日本 vs 瑞典（90 分钟赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group F: Japan vs Sweden (90-minute result)?

entries.one_liner_en: A near-200-point Elo gap and an unbeaten run make Japan clear favourites, but Mitoma/Minamino absences and Sweden's Gyokeres-Isak front line keep the upset live.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 194 分（日本 1906 vs 瑞典 1712），中立场 Davidson 模型给日本约 58% 基线胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 194-point Elo gap (Japan 1906 vs Sweden 1712) yields a ~58% baseline Japan win probability in the neutral-venue Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 日本核心攻击手三笘薫（腘绳肌）与南野拓実（ACL）双双缺席世界杯名单，削弱破密集防守能力。

key_reasons.cn: 瑞典锋线 Gyökeres（阿森纳英超夺冠队内最佳射手）+ Isak 的天赋高于其 Elo 第 43 位排名所示。
key_reasons.en: Sweden's front line of Gyokeres (Arsenal's top scorer in a title-winning season) and Isak carries more talent than its 43rd Elo rank implies.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue) p_stat 0.579/0.232/0.190, bounded evidence adjustment (-3pp Japan, +1pp draw, +2pp Sweden, within ±8pp cap), renormalized. No betting/prediction-market data consulted.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 E 组：库拉索 vs 科特迪瓦（2026-06-25，90 分钟三路赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group E: Curaçao vs Côte d'Ivoire (2026-06-25, three-way 90-minute result)
entries.one_liner_cn: 科特迪瓦 Elo 高出 261 分且刚客场击败法国，明显占优；库拉索作为首次参赛的最弱方，爆冷空间有限但末轮轮换带来不确定性。
entries.one_liner_en: Côte d'Ivoire hold a 261-point Elo edge and just beat France away — clearly stronger; debutants Curaçao have limited upset potential, though matchday-3 rotation adds uncertainty.

key_reasons.en: A 261-point Elo gap (Côte d'Ivoire 1695 vs Curaçao 1434) gives Côte d'Ivoire a 64.4% baseline win probability in the Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 科特迪瓦 6 月 4 日在南特 2-1 击败法国，队史首胜法国，状态与信心正盛。
key_reasons.en: Côte d'Ivoire beat France 2-1 in Nantes on June 4 — their first-ever win over France — signalling strong form and confidence.

key_reasons.cn: 库拉索热身赛 1-4 不敌苏格兰，面对中上强度对手防线失分明显；世界杯首秀经验欠缺。
key_reasons.en: Curaçao lost 1-4 to Scotland in their warm-up, leaking goals against mid-tier opposition, and lack World Cup experience as debutants.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) on eloratings.net ratings fetched 2026-06-11 (p_stat 14.3/21.3/64.4), plus a bounded evidence adjustment of +2.5pp toward Côte d'Ivoire (cap ±8pp) justified by cited form/depth facts; June friendlies already partly priced into Elo, hence the small delta. No betting or prediction-market data consulted.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 A 组：韩国 vs 捷克，90 分钟三路赛果？

entries.one_liner_en: Korea hold a slight edge from an 18-point Elo gap and a steadier qualification path, but all three outcomes are close and the draw risk is material.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距仅 18 分（韩国 1758 vs 捷克 1740），统计上接近抛硬币，韩国仅微弱领先。
key_reasons.en: The Elo gap is only 18 points (Korea 1758 vs Czechia 1740) — statistically near a coin flip with Korea marginally ahead.

key_reasons.cn: 韩国预选赛不败直通且核心健康、孙兴慜状态出色；捷克靠附加赛两轮点球险胜晋级，20 年来首进世界杯。
key_reasons.en: Korea qualified unbeaten with a healthy core and an in-form Son Heung-min; Czechia needed two penalty shootouts in the play-offs and are at their first World Cup in 20 years.

key_reasons.cn: 捷克 Hlozek 伤愈进入名单，进攻端有补强，限制了向韩国方向的调整幅度。
key_reasons.en: Czechia's Adam Hlozek recovered to make the squad, bolstering the attack and capping the size of the shift toward Korea.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus; p_stat 0.390/0.259/0.351) plus a bounded +2pp Korea / -2pp Czechia evidence adjustment, renormalized. Probabilities derived solely from the statistical model and cited public evidence.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 H 组：沙特阿拉伯 vs 乌拉圭（90 分钟三路赛果）

entries.one_liner_en: Uruguay hold a clear strength edge with a settled squad while Saudi Arabia changed coaches weeks before the tournament; Uruguay win at roughly 70%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 316 分（乌拉圭 1892 vs 沙特 1576），统计模型给乌拉圭约 69% 基线胜率。

key_reasons.en: Saudi Arabia replaced Renard with Donis in late April, under two months before kickoff, and went W2 L3 in their last five friendlies.

key_reasons.cn: 乌拉圭阵容齐整：Valverde 伤愈、Núñez 领衔锋线，近 5 场 4 场不败。
key_reasons.en: Uruguay are settled: Valverde recovered, Nunez leads the line, and the side is unbeaten in four of their last five.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gave 11.2/19.5/69.3; bounded evidence-based adjustment of ~2pp (cap 8pp) for Saudi coaching turmoil vs Uruguay stability, renormalized to 10/20/70. No betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 C 组：摩洛哥 vs 海地（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group C: Morocco vs Haiti (90-minute three-way result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 摩洛哥实力与大赛底蕴全面占优，但主力中卫缺阵、换帅磨合与末轮轮换风险，加上海地状态火热，让冷门概率略高于纯模型值。
entries.one_liner_en: Morocco dominate on strength and pedigree, but a key centre-back out, a coaching transition, possible matchday-3 rotation, and Haiti's hot form push the upset tail slightly above the pure model value.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距巨大：摩洛哥 1827（第 24）对海地 1548（第 73），Davidson 模型基线即给摩洛哥 66% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: Huge Elo gap: Morocco 1827 (rank 24) vs Haiti 1548 (rank 73); the Davidson baseline alone gives Morocco a 66% win probability.

key_reasons.cn: 摩洛哥主力中卫 Aguerd 与边锋 Ezzalzouli 双双伤退世界杯名单，且新帅 Ouahbi 三月才接任，削弱确定性。
key_reasons.en: Morocco lost first-choice CB Aguerd and winger Ezzalzouli to injury withdrawals from the squad, and new coach Ouahbi only took over in March, reducing certainty.

key_reasons.cn: 海地状态火热：6 月 2 日 4-0 大胜新西兰，预选赛小组头名直通，并新增 Isidor、Bellegarde 等英超级别球员。
key_reasons.en: Haiti are in hot form: a 4-0 friendly win over New Zealand on June 2, topped their qualifying group, and added Premier League-calibre players like Isidor and Bellegarde.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gives p_stat 66.0/20.7/13.3; bounded evidence adjustment of -3.0pp Morocco (+1.5pp draw, +1.5pp Haiti) for injuries, coaching transition, matchday-3 rotation risk, and Haiti form/reinforcements. No betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 A 组：墨西哥 vs 韩国（90 分钟赛果）？

key_reasons.en: Korea's core carries injury and form concerns; key midfielder Hwang In-beom made the squad while nursing an ankle injury.

entries.question_cn: 2026 FIFA 世界杯揭幕战（A 组）：墨西哥 vs 南非，墨西哥城阿兹特克体育场——90 分钟（含伤停补时）赛果：墨西哥胜 / 平局 / 南非胜
entries.question_en: 2026 FIFA World Cup opening match (Group A): Mexico vs South Africa, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City — 90-minute (regulation incl. stoppage time) result: Mexico win / Draw / South Africa win
entries.one_liner_cn: 墨西哥是明确的强势一方——主场、海拔、状态、实力差全部占优，我们给约 73% 胜率；但世界杯揭幕战历来保守、南非擅长低位防守拿平局，平局（约 20%）是最值得认真对待的非主流结局，南非取胜则是小概率尾部事件（约 7%）。
entries.one_liner_en: Mexico are the clear stronger side — home crowd, altitude, form, and the underlying strength gap all point one way, so we put their win probability at ~73%; but World Cup openers are historically cagey and South Africa's low-block defending makes the draw (~20%) the alternative outcome most worth taking seriously, while a South Africa win is a thin tail event (~7%).

key_reasons.cn: 东道主揭幕战历史基率极强（16 胜 6 平 1 负，唯一输球是 2022 卡塔尔），叠加阿兹特克约 2,240 米海拔、约 8 万主场球迷，以及墨西哥 2026 年 8 场不败对南非全年不胜的状态差。
key_reasons.en: Hosts are 16W-6D-1L in World Cup openers (the only defeat: Qatar 2022), and Mexico add ~2,240m altitude at the Azteca, ~80,000 home fans, and an unbeaten-in-8 2026 form edge over a winless South Africa.

key_reasons.cn: 揭幕战平局基率约 26%（23 场东道主揭幕战 6 平，远高于 Elo 模型的 14.9%），且南非已在帕丘卡（约 2,440 米，比墨西哥城更高）高原驻训约 9-10 天，海拔优势必须打折。
key_reasons.en: Host openers end drawn ~26% of the time (6 of 23, well above the Elo model's 14.9%), and South Africa spent ~9-10 days at altitude in Pachuca (~2,440m, higher than Mexico City), so the altitude edge must be discounted.

key_reasons.cn: 南非 2026 年至今不胜（0 胜 3 平 2 负、全年仅进 3 球），爆冷路径缺乏任何正面战绩证据，因此南非取胜只是小尾部概率。
key_reasons.en: South Africa are winless in 2026 (0W-3D-2L, only 3 goals all year), leaving the upset path with no positive results evidence — a thin tail outcome.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson-Elo statistical baseline (Elo 1875 vs 1517, home advantage +100, drawNu 0.70 → 0.7943/0.1488/0.0569) + evidence-bounded LLM adjustment (−6/+5/+1pp, cap ±8pp per outcome), fully independent of any betting or prediction market. 市场盲：Davidson-Elo 统计基线 + 有界证据调整（每项 ≤ ±8pp），完全独立于任何盘口与预测市场。

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 F 组：荷兰 vs 日本（6 月 14 日），90 分钟赛果？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group F: Netherlands vs Japan (June 14) — 90-minute result?
entries.one_liner_cn: 荷兰纸面略优但后防门将伤情叠加，状态火热的日本足以把首战拖入接近五五开的胶着局面。
entries.one_liner_en: The Netherlands edge it on paper, but with defensive and keeper injuries an in-form Japan can drag the opener close to a coin flip.

key_reasons.cn: 荷兰后卫 Timber 因伤退出世界杯，主力门将 Verbruggen 缺席 6 月 10 日训练、出战成疑
key_reasons.en: Netherlands defender Timber ruled out of the World Cup; first-choice keeper Verbruggen missed June 10 training and is a doubt

key_reasons.cn: 日本核心边锋三笘薰因腿筋伤势落选最终名单，但队长远藤航伤愈复出、中场骨架完整
key_reasons.en: Japan lose key winger Mitoma (hamstring) from the final squad, but captain Endo is back fit and the midfield spine is intact

key_reasons.cn: Elo 仅差 42 分（荷兰 1948 vs 日本 1906），中立闭顶场馆，统计基线本就接近均势
key_reasons.en: Only a 42-point Elo gap (NED 1948 vs JPN 1906) at a neutral climate-controlled venue — the statistical baseline is already near-even

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gives p_stat NED 41.6%/draw 25.8%/JPN 32.6%; bounded evidence adjustment of 3pp (NED -3, draw +1, JPN +2) for Dutch defensive/keeper injuries vs Japan's better availability; renormalized. No market prices used anywhere.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯 F 组小组赛：荷兰 vs 瑞典（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group F: Netherlands vs Sweden (three-way 90-minute result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 荷兰Elo全面占优、约六成胜率，但蒂姆贝尔与西蒙斯伤缺叠加瑞典双前锋火力，冷门窗口并未完全关闭。
entries.one_liner_en: The Netherlands hold a clear Elo edge and roughly a 60% win probability, but the Timber and Simons absences plus Sweden's strike pair keep the upset window ajar.

key_reasons.cn: Elo差距236分：荷兰1948（第8）对瑞典1712（第43），统计模型给出约62%的荷兰基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 236-point Elo gap — Netherlands 1948 (8th) vs Sweden 1712 (43rd) — yields a ~62% baseline Dutch win probability.

key_reasons.cn: 荷兰减员明显：蒂姆贝尔因腹股沟伤退出世界杯、西蒙斯ACL报销，首发结构受损。
key_reasons.en: Dutch absences bite: Timber withdrawn with a groin injury and Simons out with an ACL rupture, weakening the starting XI.

key_reasons.cn: 瑞典锋线高于其排名水平：居克雷什英超21球并附加赛绝杀波兰，但伊萨克长期伤后体能存疑。
key_reasons.en: Sweden's forwards outclass their ranking: Gyokeres scored 21 PL goals and the play-off winner vs Poland, though Isak's fitness remains in doubt.

entries.method_note: Davidson three-way Elo (scale=400, drawNu=0.7) on eloratings.net 2026-06-11 snapshot; neutral venue, no host bonus; evidence-bounded adjustment of -3.0pp Netherlands redistributed to draw/Sweden (cap +/-8pp). Market-blind: no odds or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 I 组：挪威 vs 法国（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group I: Norway vs France (three-way result, 90 minutes)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 法国实力占优、胜面约五成，但挪威黄金一代与末轮轮换变数让三路概率不宜过度集中。
entries.one_liner_en: France are clearly stronger with roughly a 50% win chance, but Norway's golden generation and final-round rotation variance argue against over-concentration.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 149 分：法国 2063（第 3）vs 挪威 1914（第 11），统计基线法国胜约 53%。
key_reasons.en: 149-point Elo gap: France 2063 (#3) vs Norway 1914 (#11), giving a statistical baseline of about 53% for a France win.

key_reasons.cn: 挪威 28 年来首进世界杯，Haaland 预选赛 16 球、国家队 55 球，球队接近历史最强档期。
key_reasons.en: Norway's first World Cup in 28 years; Haaland scored 16 qualifying goals (55 international) as the team nears a historic peak.

key_reasons.cn: 双方核心均带伤病疑问：Ødegaard 赛季至少 5 伤，Mbappé 5 月大腿伤后入选任队长，影响大体对冲。
key_reasons.en: Both key men carry injury questions: Ødegaard had at least five injuries this season; Mbappé was named captain after a May thigh injury — largely offsetting.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo (2026-06-11) -> Davidson three-way (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 22.6/24.3/53.2 -> bounded evidence adjustment +1.0/+1.0/-2.0pp -> p_final. 80% intervals from drawNu 0.6-0.8 and +/-40 Elo sensitivity. No betting or prediction-market data consulted.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 I 组：挪威 vs 塞内加尔（90 分钟三路赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group I: Norway vs Senegal (90-minute three-way result)
entries.one_liner_cn: 挪威凭 Elo 差距与哈兰德的火力小幅占优，但卫冕非洲杯冠军塞内加尔大赛经验明显更足，三路概率相当接近，挪威仅轻微领先。
entries.one_liner_en: Norway hold a slight edge on Elo and Haaland's firepower, but reigning AFCON champions Senegal bring far more tournament experience — a close three-way race with Norway only narrowly ahead.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 54 分（挪威 1914 第 11 位 vs 塞内加尔 1860 第 21 位），中立场下挪威为统计层面小热门。
key_reasons.en: A 54-point Elo gap (Norway 1914, #11 vs Senegal 1860, #21) makes Norway the statistical slight favourite on neutral ground.

key_reasons.cn: 塞内加尔是 2026 年 1 月非洲杯冠军，Mané 获赛事最佳球员，全队大赛淘汰赛经验充足。
key_reasons.en: Senegal won AFCON in January 2026 with Mané named player of the tournament — a deeply tournament-tested squad.

key_reasons.cn: 挪威 28 年来首进世界杯，哈兰德预选赛 16 球领衔且健康在列，但全队几乎无世界杯经验。
key_reasons.en: Norway return to the World Cup after 28 years; Haaland (16 qualifying goals) is fit and included, but the squad has almost no World Cup experience.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net 2026-06-11) Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, no host bonus — neutral venue) gives p_stat Norway 42.9% / Draw 25.7% / Senegal 31.4%; bounded evidence adjustment of ~2pp (within the ±8pp cap) toward Senegal for AFCON-champion tournament pedigree vs Norway's lack of World Cup experience; no injury absences reported on either side. No betting/prediction-market data consulted.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 G 组：新西兰 vs 比利时（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group G: New Zealand vs Belgium (three-way result, 90 minutes)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 比利时实力占优、约 68% 概率取胜，但末轮可能轮换且锋线带伤，新西兰拿分概率并非可以忽略。
entries.one_liner_en: Belgium are clear favourites on strength at about 68%, but possible matchday-3 rotation and injured forwards mean New Zealand's chance of taking points is not negligible.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 332 分（比利时 1894 vs 新西兰 1562），Davidson 统计模型给比利时约 70.6% 基线胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 332-point Elo gap (Belgium 1894 vs New Zealand 1562) gives Belgium a ~70.6% baseline win probability in the Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 比利时核心德布劳内与卢卡库均带伤入选，卢卡库本季仅踢约 1 小时正式比赛。
key_reasons.en: Belgium's De Bruyne and Lukaku were both selected while injured; Lukaku has played barely an hour of competitive football this season.

key_reasons.cn: 本场为 G 组末轮，比利时若提前出线可能轮换；新西兰头号射手伍德已确认完全伤愈。
key_reasons.en: This is Group G's final round and Belgium may rotate if already through; New Zealand's top striker Chris Wood is confirmed fully fit.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue) baseline 10.4/19.0/70.6, plus bounded evidence adjustment (~2.6pp total, cap 8pp), renormalized. No betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 G 组：新西兰 vs 埃及（2026-06-21，90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group G: New Zealand vs Egypt (2026-06-21, 90-minute three-way result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 埃及凭借萨拉赫领衔的整体实力与约134分的Elo优势占上风（约53.5%），但新西兰阵容齐整、伍德复出，平局加爆冷合计概率接近一半。
entries.one_liner_en: Egypt hold the edge (~53.5%) on a ~134-point Elo gap and a Salah-led attack, but with New Zealand at full strength and Wood back fit, draw-plus-upset probability is close to half.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 134 分（埃及 1696 vs 新西兰 1562），Davidson 模型基线给埃及约 51.6% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: 134-point Elo gap (Egypt 1696 vs New Zealand 1562); the Davidson baseline gives Egypt ~51.6%.

key_reasons.cn: 萨拉赫腿筋伤愈后出任队长，与曼城前锋马尔穆什领衔锋线；埃及 6 月 6 日仅 1-2 小负巴西，状态可用。
key_reasons.en: Salah, recovered from a hamstring injury, captains the side alongside Man City's Marmoush; Egypt lost only 1-2 to Brazil on June 6, showing serviceable form.

key_reasons.cn: 新西兰队长伍德 12 月膝伤手术后宣称完全恢复，但 34 岁且术后回归时间短，国际强度下锐度存疑。
key_reasons.en: New Zealand captain Chris Wood declares himself fully fit after December knee surgery, but at 34 with a short run-in, his sharpness at international intensity is uncertain.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net snapshot (2026-06-11) fed into Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) giving p_stat 23.9/24.6/51.6; bounded evidence adjustment of ~3.8pp total (cap 8pp) toward Egypt for attacking quality and form, renormalized. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity and thin pre-opener evidence. No betting or prediction-market data consulted.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 L 组：巴拿马 vs 英格兰（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group L: Panama vs England (90-minute three-way result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 英格兰实力碾压、约三分之二概率取胜，但末轮轮换可能与巴拿马核心带伤令平局空间略升，巴拿马爆冷空间有限。
entries.one_liner_en: England's class dominates with roughly a two-thirds win probability; possible matchday-3 rotation and Panama's injured playmaker slightly lift the draw, while Panama's upset ceiling stays low.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 294 分（英格兰 2024 vs 巴拿马 1730），Davidson 模型基准给出英胜约 67%。
key_reasons.en: A 294-point Elo gap (England 2024 vs Panama 1730) yields a ~67% England-win baseline in the Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 英格兰 26 人名单接近全主力，仅边后卫线有轻微伤病隐患，凯恩领衔。
key_reasons.en: England's 26-man squad is near full strength with only minor fullback fitness flags, led by Harry Kane.

key_reasons.cn: 末轮英格兰或已出线存在轮换可能；巴拿马核心卡拉斯基利亚带腹股沟伤，压制爆冷上限。
key_reasons.en: England may already be qualified by matchday 3 (rotation plausible); Panama playmaker Carrasquilla carries a groin injury, capping the upset ceiling.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 12.4/20.2/67.4, plus a bounded evidence-based adjustment (~2pp total, cap +/-8pp), renormalized. No betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 L 组：巴拿马 vs 克罗地亚（90 分钟三路赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group L: Panama vs Croatia (90-minute three-way result)
entries.one_liner_cn: 克罗地亚凭 182 分 Elo 优势与完整主力明显占优，但巴拿马状态佳且坐拥多伦多准主场，爆冷概率不可忽视。
entries.one_liner_en: Croatia's 182-point Elo edge and full-strength squad make them clear favourites, but in-form Panama with a quasi-home Toronto crowd keep upset chances non-trivial.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 182 分（克罗地亚 1912 / 世界第 12 vs 巴拿马 1730 / 第 38），统计模型给出克罗地亚约 57% 胜率基线。
key_reasons.en: A 182-point Elo gap (Croatia 1912, world No. 12 vs Panama 1730, No. 38) yields a ~57% statistical baseline win probability for Croatia.

key_reasons.cn: 克罗地亚主力齐整：莫德里奇颧骨骨折后伤愈出战第五届世界杯，格瓦迪奥尔 5 月 14 日已复出。
key_reasons.en: Croatia at full strength: Modric fit for his fifth World Cup after a cheekbone fracture, and Gvardiol returned to action on May 14.

key_reasons.cn: 巴拿马近期状态佳（2025 国联决赛、最近 2-1 胜南非），且前两轮均在多伦多进行，准主场与赛程便利构成小幅上调依据。
key_reasons.en: Panama arrive in form (2025 Nations League finalists, beat South Africa 2-1 most recently) and play both opening matches in Toronto, a quasi-home and scheduling edge justifying a small upgrade.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gives p_stat 19.9/23.5/56.7; bounded evidence adjustment of ~2.2pp net from Croatia toward Panama/draw (cap ±8pp), renormalized. No betting odds or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯 D 组：巴拉圭 vs 澳大利亚，90 分钟三路赛果？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group D: Paraguay vs Australia, 90-minute three-way result?

entries.one_liner_en: Elo gives Paraguay a modest edge, but with each side missing a key midfielder and Australia exceptionally well prepared, the 41/27/32 split means this match remains wide open.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 1834（第 22）对 1777（第 28），巴拉圭仅领先 57 分，属小幅优势而非压倒性差距。
key_reasons.en: Elo 1834 (#22) vs 1777 (#28): Paraguay's 57-point lead is a modest, not dominant, edge.

key_reasons.cn: 澳大利亚主力中场 Riley McGree 腿筋伤退，此伤较新、Elo 尚未消化；巴拉圭的 Villasanti（ACL）缺阵则已被近期战绩部分反映。
key_reasons.en: Australia loses expected starter Riley McGree (hamstring), a fresh blow not yet in Elo; Paraguay's Villasanti (ACL) absence is already partly absorbed by recent results.

key_reasons.cn: 澳大利亚自 4 月起在佛州 Sarasota 长期集训、最早抵美，气候与时差适应优势明显。
key_reasons.en: Australia has trained in Sarasota, Florida since April — the first team to begin US-based preparation, a clear acclimatization edge.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo (2026-06-11) + Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) giving 43.2/25.7/31.1; bounded evidence adjustment of 2pp (Paraguay -2, draw +1, Australia +1) for the fresher McGree injury and Australia's preparation edge. No betting/prediction-market data consulted.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 K 组：葡萄牙 vs 刚果民主共和国（90 分钟三路赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group K: Portugal vs DR Congo (90-minute three-way result)
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 差 337 分叠加葡萄牙全主力，实力差异显著；刚果（金）现实路径是防守拖平，爆冷取胜约一成。
entries.one_liner_en: A 337-point Elo gap plus a full-strength Portugal squad makes this a heavy mismatch; DR Congo's realistic path is a defensive draw, with roughly a one-in-ten upset chance.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 337 分：葡萄牙 1989（第 6）对刚果（金）1652（第 55），统计基线即约七成葡胜。
key_reasons.en: 337-point Elo gap: Portugal 1989 (rank 6) vs DR Congo 1652 (rank 55); the statistical baseline alone gives Portugal about 70%.

key_reasons.cn: 葡萄牙全员可用：5-19 公布 26 人名单，C 罗伤愈领衔第 6 次世界杯，热身赛连胜智利、尼日利亚。
key_reasons.en: Portugal at full strength: 26-man squad named May 19, Ronaldo recovered to captain a record 6th World Cup, with warm-up wins over Chile and Nigeria.

key_reasons.cn: 刚果（金）防守有组织但火力有限：0-0 平丹麦、1-2 负于刚被葡萄牙击败的智利，平局是其最现实的拿分路径。
key_reasons.en: DR Congo organized but blunt: 0-0 vs Denmark and a 1-2 loss to the Chile side Portugal just beat; a draw is their most realistic outcome.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) on eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11 gives p_stat 70.97/18.83/10.20; bounded evidence adjustment of 1pp from Portugal win to draw (DR Congo low-block solidity vs Denmark, cautious opener dynamics); 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity plus evidence thinness. No betting or prediction-market data consulted.

entries.question_cn: 2026世界杯K组小组赛（2026-06-23，休斯敦）：葡萄牙 vs 乌兹别克斯坦，90分钟三路赛果？

entries.one_liner_en: Portugal hold a clear edge in strength, form, and experience at roughly 68% to win; debutants Uzbekistan are likelier to defend for a draw than to win outright.

key_reasons.cn: Elo差距275分（1989对1714），中立场Davidson模型给出葡萄牙约65.7%基准胜率
key_reasons.en: A 275-point Elo gap (1989 vs 1714) yields about a 65.7% baseline win probability for Portugal in the neutral-venue Davidson model

key_reasons.cn: 葡萄牙为欧国联卫冕冠军且状态出色，C罗伤愈于5月19日入选并任队长
key_reasons.en: Portugal are reigning Nations League champions in strong form, with Ronaldo recovered and named captain in the May 19 squad

key_reasons.cn: 乌兹别克斯坦世界杯首秀，26人中15人来自国内联赛，核心中卫库萨诺夫赛季出场有限、状态存疑
key_reasons.en: World Cup debutants Uzbekistan field 15 of 26 from the domestic league, and key centre-back Khusanov has sharpness doubts after an injury-curtailed season

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) on eloratings.net snapshot -> p_stat 65.7/20.8/13.5; bounded evidence adjustment +2.3pp to Portugal (form, full squad vs debutant inexperience and Khusanov fitness), renormalized. entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 B 组：卡塔尔 vs 瑞士（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group B: Qatar vs Switzerland (90-minute three-way result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 差距 470 分叠加卡塔尔赛前低迷，瑞士约 82% 大概率取胜，平局仍留约 13.5% 空间。
entries.one_liner_en: A 470-point Elo gap plus Qatar's poor pre-tournament form puts Switzerland at ~82% to win, with the draw still around 13.5%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 评分 1891 vs 1421（差 470 分），Davidson 模型给出瑞士约 80% 的基准胜率
key_reasons.en: Elo ratings 1891 vs 1421 (470-point gap); the Davidson model yields a ~80% baseline win probability for Switzerland

key_reasons.cn: 瑞士预选赛 4 胜 2 平不败、6 场仅失 2 球，且无重大伤停，扎卡第 4 次连续出战世界杯
key_reasons.en: Switzerland went unbeaten in qualifying (W4 D2, 2 goals conceded in 6) with no notable absentees; Xhaka makes his 4th straight World Cup

key_reasons.cn: 卡塔尔近 4 场正式比赛输 3 场，2025 阿拉伯杯小组出局（0-3 负突尼斯）
key_reasons.en: Qatar lost 3 of their last 4 competitive matches and exited the 2025 Arab Cup at the group stage (0-3 to Tunisia)

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gave 5.4/14.5/80.1; bounded evidence adjustment of ~1.9pp toward Switzerland (full-strength squad, solid qualifying defence vs Qatar's form slump), renormalized. entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 A 组：南非 vs 韩国（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group A: South Africa vs Korea Republic (90-minute three-way result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 差距 241 分使韩国约六成占优，但第三轮轮换不确定性让南非爆冷加逼平合计仍近四成。
entries.one_liner_en: A 241-point Elo gap gives Korea Republic roughly a 60% edge, though matchday-3 rotation uncertainty keeps South Africa's combined upset-or-draw chance near 40%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 241 分（韩国 1758 / 第 33 vs 南非 1517 / 第 80），是基准概率的主导因素。
key_reasons.en: 241-point Elo gap (Korea 1758 / rank 33 vs South Africa 1517 / rank 80) dominates the baseline probabilities.

key_reasons.cn: 韩国中场黄仁范带踝伤隐患入选，中卫曹侑珉伤退由赵渭济顶替，阵容深度小幅受损。
key_reasons.en: Korea midfielder Hwang In-beom was selected despite an ankle concern and centre-back Cho Yu-min withdrew injured (replaced by Cho Wi-je), slightly denting squad depth.

key_reasons.cn: 南非除已恢复合练的 Modiba 外无重大伤情，且双方三场小组赛都在墨西哥，环境适应度对等。
key_reasons.en: South Africa has no major absences (Modiba back in full training), and both sides play all group games in Mexico, so acclimatization is symmetric.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, no host bonus — neither team is a host) gives p_stat 0.156/0.219/0.625; bounded evidence adjustment of 2pp total (Korea −2pp toward SA win and draw) then renormalized. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6–0.8 sensitivity plus thin evidence and unknown matchday-3 stakes.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 C 组：苏格兰 vs 巴西（2026-06-24，90 分钟赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group C: Scotland vs Brazil (2026-06-24, 90-minute result)
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 差距 209 分叠加苏格兰中场核心吉尔莫尔伤退、巴西阵容深度完整且内马尔预计小组赛内复出，巴西约六成胜率。
entries.one_liner_en: A 209-point Elo gap, Scotland losing midfield hub Billy Gilmour, and Brazil's deep squad with Neymar expected back during the group stage give Brazil roughly a 60% win probability.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 实力差巨大：巴西 1991（第 5）对苏格兰 1782（第 26），Davidson 统计模型给巴西 59.4% 基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: Large Elo gap: Brazil 1991 (#5) vs Scotland 1782 (#26); the Davidson model gives Brazil a 59.4% baseline win probability.

key_reasons.cn: 苏格兰中场核心吉尔莫尔膝伤退出世界杯，由弗莱彻递补；前锋亚当斯大腿伤势成疑。
key_reasons.en: Scotland's midfield hub Billy Gilmour is out of the World Cup with a knee injury (Tyler Fletcher called up); striker Che Adams is a thigh-injury doubt.

key_reasons.cn: 内马尔 2 级肌肉拉伤预计缺席 2-3 周，但安切洛蒂预期其小组赛内复出；巴西其余主力齐整、阵容深度极强。
key_reasons.en: Neymar's grade 2 muscle strain sidelines him 2-3 weeks, but Ancelotti expects him back during the group stage; the rest of Brazil's squad is intact and very deep.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net 2026-06-11) -> Davidson three-way (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 0.178/0.228/0.594; bounded evidence adjustment (Scotland -2.0pp injuries, Brazil +1.5pp depth/Neymar return, draw +0.5pp rotation scenario; |delta| ~4pp of max 8pp) -> p_final 0.158/0.233/0.609.
