entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 C 组：苏格兰 vs 摩洛哥（2026-06-19）90 分钟赛果？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group C: Scotland vs Morocco (2026-06-19) — 90-minute result?
entries.one_liner_cn: 摩洛哥凭更高 Elo 与大赛经验略占上风（约43%），苏格兰阵容齐整不容小觑（约31%），平局概率可观（26%）。
entries.one_liner_en: Morocco hold a clear but not overwhelming edge (~43%) on Elo and tournament pedigree; a fully assembled Scotland sit near 31% with the draw live at 26%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 45 分（摩洛哥 1827 vs 苏格兰 1782），中立场地下统计模型给摩洛哥明显但不压倒的优势。
key_reasons.en: A 45-point Elo gap (Morocco 1827 vs Scotland 1782) on a neutral venue gives Morocco a clear but moderate statistical edge.

key_reasons.cn: 苏格兰中场核心 Billy Gilmour 5 月 30 日热身赛伤退，球衣号显示由 Tyler Fletcher 顶替，中场控制力受损。
key_reasons.en: Scotland's midfield anchor Billy Gilmour went off injured in the May 30 friendly; squad numbers suggest Tyler Fletcher replaces him, weakening midfield control.

key_reasons.cn: 摩洛哥主力前锋 En-Nesyri 落选、新帅 Ouahbi 首次执教成年队世界杯，不确定性限制了向摩洛哥方向的更大上调。
key_reasons.en: Morocco left out first-choice striker En-Nesyri and new coach Ouahbi is at his first senior World Cup — uncertainty that capped a larger shift toward Morocco.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) -> p_stat SCO 32.3% / Draw 25.8% / MAR 41.9%; bounded evidence adjustment (~1.3pp of max 8pp) -> p_final 31/26/43. 80% intervals from drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity plus evidence thinness. No market inputs of any kind.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 I 组：塞内加尔 vs 伊拉克（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group I: Senegal vs Iraq (90-minute three-way result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 非洲杯冠军塞内加尔满员出战、Elo 高出 253 分，对小组最弱的伊拉克占据明显优势，但末轮出线形势未知带来轮换变数。
entries.one_liner_en: AFCON champions Senegal, at full strength and 253 Elo points ahead, hold a clear edge over the group's weakest side Iraq, though unknown matchday-3 stakes add rotation risk.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 253 分（塞内加尔 1860 vs 伊拉克 1607），Davidson 模型给出约 64% 的基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 253-point Elo gap (Senegal 1860 vs Iraq 1607) yields a ~64% baseline win probability in the Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 塞内加尔以非洲杯冠军身份满员出战：马内领衔，帕普·萨尔与哈比卜·迪亚拉伤愈复出。
key_reasons.en: Senegal arrive as AFCON champions at full strength: Mane headlines the squad, with Pape Sarr and Habib Diarra back from injury.

key_reasons.cn: 伊拉克阵容深度有限：26 人名单多效力国内联赛，旅欧主力仅伊克巴尔、哈马迪等少数人。
key_reasons.en: Iraq's depth is limited: the 26-man squad is mostly domestic-based, with only a few Europe-based regulars such as Zidane Iqbal and Ali Al-Hamadi.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo -> Davidson three-way (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 63.6/21.5/14.8; bounded evidence adjustment (+1.4pp Senegal, +0.5pp draw, -1.9pp Iraq; cap +/-8pp) -> p_final 65/22/13. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 and +/-25 Elo sensitivity.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯 F 组小组赛：瑞典 vs 突尼斯（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group F: Sweden vs Tunisia (three-way result, 90 minutes)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 瑞典凭约克雷斯+伊萨克的锋线优势小幅占优，但突尼斯防守极稳且瑞典状态起伏大，三路都不该被排除。
entries.one_liner_en: Sweden hold a modest edge via the Gyokeres-Isak forward line, but Tunisia's rock-solid defence and Sweden's volatility keep every outcome live.

key_reasons.cn: 瑞典锋线档次高于其 Elo 排名：约克雷斯随阿森纳夺 2025-26 英超冠军，附加赛戴帽并绝杀波兰，伊萨克同样在阵。
key_reasons.en: Sweden's forwards outclass their Elo rank: Gyokeres won the 2025-26 Premier League with Arsenal, scored a playoff hat-trick and the late winner vs Poland; Isak is also in the squad.

key_reasons.cn: 突尼斯预选赛零失球但 1 月临阵换帅，拉穆奇备战时间有限且名单大幅轮换，赢球上限受压。
key_reasons.en: Tunisia conceded zero goals in qualifying but changed coach in January; Lamouchi has had limited preparation with a much-changed squad, capping their win ceiling.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 84 分（1712 vs 1628）+ 中立场地，统计模型给出瑞典 46.2/平 25.4/突尼斯 28.5 的基线。
key_reasons.en: An 84-point Elo gap (1712 vs 1628) on neutral ground yields a statistical baseline of Sweden 46.2 / Draw 25.4 / Tunisia 28.5.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, no host bonus, neutral venue) -> p_stat Sweden 46.2/Draw 25.4/Tunisia 28.5; bounded evidence adjustment (total ~4.9pp of max 8pp) for Sweden's elite forwards vs Tunisia's coaching upheaval and defensive solidity; renormalized to 48/26/26. No market inputs of any kind.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 F 组：突尼斯 vs 日本（2026-06-21）90 分钟三路赛果？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group F: Tunisia vs Japan (2026-06-21) — three-way result after 90 minutes?
entries.one_liner_cn: 日本 Elo 高出 278 分构成压倒性实力差，三笘薰、南野拓实伤缺被突尼斯换帅动荡与 0-5 热身惨败大致抵消，日本约 2/3 概率取胜。
entries.one_liner_en: Japan's 278-point Elo edge is decisive; the Mitoma/Minamino injuries are roughly offset by Tunisia's coaching upheaval and a 0-5 warm-up collapse, leaving Japan winning about 2 times in 3.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 实力差巨大：日本 1906（第 14）对突尼斯 1628（第 58），278 分差距让统计模型给出日本约 66% 基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: Huge Elo gap: Japan 1906 (rank 14) vs Tunisia 1628 (rank 58); the 278-point gap gives Japan a ~66% baseline win probability in the statistical model.

key_reasons.cn: 日本双翼伤缺：三笘薰（腿筋伤）与南野拓实均无缘世界杯，进攻宽度与爆点削弱，小幅下修日本优势。
key_reasons.en: Japan missing both star wingers: Mitoma (hamstring) and Minamino are out of the World Cup, trimming Japan's attacking width and edge slightly.

key_reasons.cn: 突尼斯动荡：拉穆希 1 月上任仅带队 2 场、老将集体落选，6 月热身又 0-5 惨败比利时，抵消了日本的伤病减分。
key_reasons.en: Tunisia in flux: Lamouchi has only 2 matches in charge since January, veterans were dropped, and a 0-5 June friendly loss to Belgium offsets Japan's injury downgrade.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gives p_stat Tunisia 13.3% / Draw 20.7% / Japan 66.0%; bounded evidence adjustment (net ~2.6pp, cap 8pp) yields p_final. No betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 F 组：突尼斯 vs 荷兰（90 分钟三路赛果）
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group F: Tunisia vs Netherlands (90-minute three-way result)
entries.one_liner_cn: 荷兰 Elo 高出 320 分且突尼斯热身赛 0-5 崩盘，蒂姆贝尔缺阵影响有限，荷兰胜率约 73%。
entries.one_liner_en: With a 320-point Elo edge and Tunisia's 0-5 warm-up collapse, Timber's absence barely dents a ~73% Dutch win probability.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 320 分：荷兰 1948（第 8）对突尼斯 1628（第 58），实力差距悬殊。
key_reasons.en: 320-point Elo gap: Netherlands 1948 (8th) vs Tunisia 1628 (58th) — a heavily lopsided matchup.

key_reasons.cn: 突尼斯最后一场热身 0-5 惨败比利时，主帅 Lamouchi 公开道歉，且其 2026 年初才接手球队。
key_reasons.en: Tunisia lost their final warm-up 0-5 to Belgium, prompting a public apology from coach Lamouchi, who only took over in early 2026.

key_reasons.cn: 荷兰后卫蒂姆贝尔因腹股沟伤势无缘世界杯，Geertruida 补招，防线深度小幅受损。
key_reasons.en: Netherlands defender Jurrien Timber misses the World Cup with a groin injury; Geertruida called up, modestly thinning defensive depth.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, no host bonus) gave 11.0/19.4/69.6; bounded evidence adjustment of 6pp total (cap ±8pp) shifted to 9.0/18.4/72.6. Independent of all betting/prediction-market prices.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯 D 组小组赛：土耳其 vs 巴拉圭（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group D: Türkiye vs Paraguay — three-way result over 90 minutes?
entries.one_liner_cn: 土耳其凭 Elo 优势与锋线状态略占上风，但巴拉圭防线老练扎实，平局与冷门空间不小。
entries.one_liner_en: Türkiye hold a moderate edge on Elo and attacking form, but Paraguay's seasoned defence keeps the draw and upset paths live.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 77 分（土耳其 1911 第 13 vs 巴拉圭 1834 第 22），中立场地无主场加成，构成温和而非压倒性优势。
key_reasons.en: A 77-point Elo gap (Türkiye 1911 #13 vs Paraguay 1834 #22) at a neutral venue with no host bonus — a moderate, not overwhelming, edge.

key_reasons.cn: 土耳其锋线状态出色：热身赛 2-1 胜委内瑞拉，Yıldız 本赛季 14 球、Güler 串联出色。
key_reasons.en: Türkiye's attack is in form: 2-1 warm-up win over Venezuela, with Yıldız on 14 goals this season and Güler creating well.

key_reasons.cn: 巴拉圭防守骨架完整：Alfaro 体系依赖 Gómez、Alderete 的老练防线，全队无重大伤停报告。
key_reasons.en: Paraguay's defensive spine is intact: Alfaro's setup leans on the experienced Gómez-Alderete axis, with no major injuries reported.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue) gives 45.4/25.5/29.1; bounded evidence adjustment of ~1pp total (form vs defensive solidity offset, thin pre-tournament evidence) yields 45/26/29. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity plus evidence thinness. No betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 D 组：土耳其 vs 美国（2026-06-25），90 分钟三路赛果？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group D: Türkiye vs United States (2026-06-25) — three-way result after 90 minutes?
entries.one_liner_cn: 土耳其纸面实力明显占优，但美国东道主主场之利大幅缩窄差距，土耳其胜率约45%，平局加美国胜合计约55%，悬念不小。
entries.one_liner_en: Türkiye holds a clear on-paper edge, but US host advantage narrows it substantially — roughly 45% Türkiye, with draw plus US win totaling about 55%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 185 分：土耳其 1911（第13）vs 美国 1726（第39），纸面实力明显占优。
key_reasons.en: 185-point Elo gap: Türkiye 1911 (rank 13) vs USA 1726 (rank 39) — a clear on-paper edge.

key_reasons.cn: 美国为东道主，小组赛全部本土作战，本场在洛杉矶 SoFi 体育场，模型计入 +100 主场加成。
key_reasons.en: The US is a host nation playing all group matches at home; this one is at SoFi Stadium, Los Angeles, modeled with a +100 host bonus.

key_reasons.cn: 土耳其两名核心创造者带近期肌肉伤史（Çalhanoğlu 5 月比目鱼肌拉伤、Güler 4 月股二头肌伤），美国则伤缺主力后腰 Cardoso，双向伤情致净调整幅度很小。
key_reasons.en: Türkiye's two key creators carry recent muscle injuries (Çalhanoğlu soleus strain in May, Güler hamstring in April), while the US is missing starting DM Cardoso — offsetting injuries keep the net adjustment small.

entries.method_note: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7) on eloratings.net ratings with +100 host bonus for USA home group match; p_stat 46.3/25.4/28.4 shifted by a bounded evidence-based adjustment of 1.3pp total (Türkiye creator injury history vs offsetting US absences). Market-blind: no betting or prediction-market data consulted.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 H 组：乌拉圭 vs 佛得角（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group H: Uruguay vs Cabo Verde (three-way result, 90 minutes)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 乌拉圭实力与阵容厚度全面占优，常规时间取胜约68%，但佛得角是组织性强的世界杯新军，平局加冷门仍有约三分之一概率。
entries.one_liner_en: Uruguay dominate on strength and depth (~68% to win in 90 minutes), but well-organized debutants Cabo Verde leave draw-plus-upset at roughly one-third probability.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距达 314 分（乌拉圭 1892 vs 佛得角 1578），Davidson 三路模型给出乌拉圭约 69% 的基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 314-point Elo gap (Uruguay 1892 vs Cabo Verde 1578) yields a ~69% baseline win probability for Uruguay in the Davidson three-way model.

key_reasons.cn: 乌拉圭主力齐整：Valverde、Araújo、Ugarte 领衔 26 人名单，仅 Bentancur 因重伤存在出战疑问。
key_reasons.en: Uruguay are near full strength: Valverde, Araujo and Ugarte headline the 26-man squad; only Bentancur is a fitness doubt after a serious injury.

key_reasons.cn: 佛得角史上首次参加世界杯，大赛经验空白，但球队组织性强、士气高昂，迈阿密湿热气候对其并非劣势。
key_reasons.en: Cabo Verde are first-time World Cup participants with no tournament pedigree but strong organization and morale; Miami's heat is no disadvantage for them.

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net 2026-06-11) -> Davidson three-way (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 69.1/19.6/11.3; bounded evidence adjustment -1.1pp off Uruguay (Bentancur doubt, organized debutant opponent, heat-neutral venue), renormalized to 68/20/12. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity and thin evidence. No betting/prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 H 组：乌拉圭 vs 西班牙（90 分钟三路赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group H: Uruguay vs Spain (three-way result, 90 minutes)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 西班牙 Elo 世界第一、实力优势明显，但小组末轮双方大概率已出线且西班牙有伤情隐患，平局概率略高于纯模型值。
entries.one_liner_en: Spain are the world's top Elo side and clear stronger team, but with both likely already qualified in the final group match and Spain carrying fitness doubts, the draw deserves slightly more weight than the raw model gives.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距巨大：西班牙 2157（世界第 1）对乌拉圭 1892（第 16），中立场统计基线西班牙胜率约 65%。
key_reasons.en: Huge Elo gap: Spain 2157 (world No. 1) vs Uruguay 1892 (No. 16); neutral-venue statistical baseline gives Spain about 65%.

key_reasons.cn: 末轮赛程结构：双方前两轮对手均为佛得角与沙特，末轮相遇时大概率已双双出线，轮换与保平倾向抬高平局概率。
key_reasons.en: Schedule structure: both face Cape Verde and Saudi Arabia first, so both are likely already through by Matchday 3, with rotation and risk-aversion inflating the draw.

key_reasons.cn: 西班牙伤情不确定性：Merino 2 月右脚应力性骨折手术能否赶上存疑，Yamal 赛季末腿筋问题、整季多次受伤。
key_reasons.en: Spain fitness uncertainty: Merino's February right-foot stress-fracture surgery leaves his readiness in doubt; Yamal ended an injury-hit season with a hamstring problem.

entries.method_note: Market-blind. Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus): Uruguay 14.1% / Draw 21.1% / Spain 64.8%. Bounded evidence adjustment of +1/+2/-3pp (total 6pp, within the 8pp cap) for likely dead-rubber rotation dynamics and Spain's fitness doubts, renormalized. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity and 15-day lineup/group-state uncertainty.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 D 组：美国 vs 澳大利亚（90 分钟赛果）？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group D: United States vs Australia (90-minute result)?
entries.one_liner_cn: 美国坐拥西雅图主场以约41%小幅领先，但澳大利亚Elo更高、备战最充分，平局与客队爆冷空间不小。
entries.one_liner_en: The USA edge ahead at about 41% on true home advantage in Seattle, but Australia carry the higher Elo and the most thorough preparation — meaningful room for a draw or an away win.

key_reasons.cn: 真主场优势：比赛在西雅图 Lumen Field 进行，美国作为东道主全部小组赛都在本土，模型按惯例给 +100 Elo 主场加成，这是美国概率领先的主因。
key_reasons.en: Genuine home advantage: the match is at Lumen Field, Seattle; as co-hosts the USA play all group matches on home soil, earning the standard +100 Elo host bonus — the main driver of their edge.

key_reasons.cn: 两队伤情大致抵消但美国略重：美国失去主力后腰 Cardoso、前锋 Agyemang，主力中卫 Richards 伤愈状态存疑；澳大利亚缺 McGree、Yazbek、Miller。
key_reasons.en: Injuries roughly offset but tilt slightly against the USA: Cardoso (first-choice DM) and Agyemang are out and starting CB Richards is a fitness doubt; Australia miss McGree, Yazbek and Miller.

key_reasons.cn: 评级信号相反：Elo 上澳大利亚 1777（第28）高于美国 1726（第39），但 FIFA 排名美国第16高于澳洲第27——基本面接近，比赛结果不确定性高。
key_reasons.en: Rating systems disagree: Elo has Australia (1777, No. 28) above the USA (1726, No. 39), while FIFA ranks the USA 16th vs Australia 27th — fundamentals are close and uncertainty is high.

entries.method_note: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7) with +100 host bonus for USA home group match; p_stat 42.3/25.7/31.9 then bounded evidence adjustment of -1pp USA / +1pp Australia (injury balance, send-off loss). Market-blind: no odds or prediction-market inputs.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 D 组：美国 vs 巴拉圭，90 分钟赛果？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group D: United States vs Paraguay — 90-minute result?
entries.one_liner_cn: 实力极为接近的均势开局：巴拉圭 Elo 更高但核心恩西索伤疑，美国坐拥东道主主场之利，胜负接近五五开、平局风险不低。
entries.one_liner_en: A near coin-flip opener: Paraguay carry the higher Elo but creator Enciso is doubtful, while the USA enjoy true host-nation advantage; draw risk is substantial.

key_reasons.cn: 巴拉圭头号进攻核心恩西索 6 月 5 日热身赛受伤被担架抬下，MRI 排除结构性撕裂但首战出战成疑。
key_reasons.en: Paraguay's primary creator Julio Enciso was stretchered off in the June 5 friendly; an MRI ruled out a structural tear but he is highly doubtful for the opener.

key_reasons.cn: 美国主力中卫 Richards 踝部韧带伤后 6 月 8 日才恢复合练，预计无法首发，削弱美国防线。
key_reasons.en: USA starting CB Chris Richards only resumed full training June 8 after tearing two ankle ligaments and is unlikely to start, weakening the US back line.

key_reasons.cn: 比赛在加州 SoFi Stadium 进行，美国作为东道主获得真实主场优势，模型 +100 主场分使两队修正后实力几乎持平（Elo 1726+100 vs 1834）。
key_reasons.en: Played at SoFi Stadium in California, the USA get genuine host advantage; the model's +100 host bonus leaves adjusted strength almost even (Elo 1726+100 vs 1834).

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, +100 host bonus for USA group matches) gives p_stat USA 36.2/draw 25.9/PAR 37.9; bounded evidence adjustment of +1.5pp USA / -1.5pp PAR (Enciso loss outweighs Richards loss). No betting or prediction-market inputs used.

entries.question_cn: 2026世界杯小组赛K组：乌兹别克斯坦 vs 哥伦比亚（2026-06-17）90分钟赛果？
entries.question_en: 2026 World Cup Group K: Uzbekistan vs Colombia (2026-06-17) — 90-minute result?
entries.one_liner_cn: 哥伦比亚实力、状态与阵容完整度全面占优，约65%概率取胜；乌兹别克斯坦首秀且队长舒穆罗多夫伤情存疑，防守拖平是其最现实出路。
entries.one_liner_en: Colombia hold a comprehensive edge in strength, form and availability (~65% to win); debutants Uzbekistan, with captain Shomurodov an injury doubt, are most likely chasing a defensive draw.

key_reasons.cn: Elo差距268分（哥伦比亚1982 vs 乌兹别克斯坦1714），Davidson模型给出哥伦比亚约65%基准胜率
key_reasons.en: 268-point Elo gap (Colombia 1982 vs Uzbekistan 1714); the Davidson model gives Colombia ~65% baseline win probability

key_reasons.cn: 乌兹别克斯坦队长、国家队史射手王Shomurodov在6月8日友谊赛对荷兰第24分钟伤退，首战出场存疑
key_reasons.en: Uzbekistan captain and all-time top scorer Shomurodov went off injured in the 24th minute vs the Netherlands on Jun 8; doubtful for the opener

key_reasons.cn: 哥伦比亚26人名单无伤病报告，J罗与迪亚斯领衔，6月8日2-0完胜约旦，状态上佳
key_reasons.en: Colombia's 26-man squad has no reported injuries; James and Diaz lead the side after a 2-0 win over Jordan on Jun 8

entries.method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gave 13.9/21.1/65.0; bounded evidence adjustment of ~2.8pp total (cap 8pp) for Shomurodov injury doubt, Colombia availability/form, and Uzbekistan's defensive 5-4-1 raising draw likelihood; renormalized to 12.5/22.0/65.5. No betting or prediction-market inputs used.

entries.question_cn: A 组头名（小组第一出线）是哪支球队？
entries.question_en: Which team finishes first in Group A?
entries.one_liner_cn: 墨西哥坐拥三场本土高原比赛、Elo 与近期状态全面领先，约 77% 概率拿下 A 组头名；韩国与捷克之间的差距小于一场比赛的偶然性，南非仅剩数学可能。
entries.one_liner_en: With all three group games on home altitude soil and a clear lead in Elo and form, Mexico wins Group A about 77% of the time; the South Korea-Czechia gap is smaller than one match's randomness, and South Africa retains only a mathematical chance.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 + 三场本土主场：墨西哥 1875（第18）对韩国 1758 / 捷克 1740 / 南非 1517，且小组赛全部在墨西哥高原进行（模型小组赛 +100 主场修正），10 万次蒙特卡洛给出 78.9% 头名基线。
key_reasons.en: Elo gap plus three home games: Mexico 1875 (#18) vs South Korea 1758 / Czechia 1740 / South Africa 1517, with every group game on Mexican altitude soil (+100 host Elo in group play), yielding a 78.9% first-place baseline over 100k Monte Carlo simulations.

key_reasons.cn: 墨西哥状态佐证基线：2026 年 8 场热身不败、仅丢 2 球，末战 5-1 塞尔维亚；仅因纯 Elo 泊松低估平局、2025 年底 6 场不胜而小幅下调 2pp。
key_reasons.en: Mexico's form supports the baseline: unbeaten in 8 friendlies in 2026 with 2 goals conceded, closing 5-1 over Serbia; only a 2pp trim for the Elo-Poisson draw underestimate and the winless run that ended 2025.

key_reasons.cn: 两支追赶者均满编但证据不足以大调：韩国孙兴慜伤愈领衔第四次世界杯（黄仁范带踝伤）；捷克 Schick 伤愈、Hložek 回归但末轮客战阿兹特克——各 +1pp。
key_reasons.en: Both challengers are at full strength but evidence supports only small shifts: Son Heung-min leads a fit Korea spine (Hwang In-beom's ankle a concern); Czechia regains Schick and Hlozek but closes away at the Azteca — +1pp each.

entries.method_note: 100k full-tournament pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, +100 host Elo in group matches, no market input) as statistical baseline; bounded evidence adjustment of at most ±4pp per team (applied: Mexico -2pp, South Korea +1pp, Czechia +1pp, South Africa 0), net zero so the distribution sums to 1. Fully market-blind.

entries.question_cn: B 组头名（小组第一出线）是哪支球队？
entries.question_en: Which team finishes first in Group B?
entries.one_liner_cn: 瑞士与东道主加拿大几乎五五开，但加拿大开赛前伤病扎堆（戴维斯、邦比托、大卫），天平略向阵容完整的瑞士倾斜。
entries.one_liner_en: Switzerland and host Canada are near a coin flip, but Canada's pre-tournament injury cluster (Davies, Bombito, David) tilts the scale slightly toward a fully intact Switzerland.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 上瑞士（1891，第17）领先加拿大（1788，第25），加上东道主小组赛 +100 Elo 加成后，10 万次模拟中两队头名概率 50.0% vs 48.0%，本质是双雄之争。
key_reasons.en: On Elo, Switzerland (1891, No. 17) lead Canada (1788, No. 25); with the +100 host bonus in group games, the 100k-sim baseline is 50.0% vs 48.0% — effectively a two-horse race.

key_reasons.cn: 加拿大开赛前减员严重：队长戴维斯腿筋伤、首战存疑，主力中卫邦比托据报道因伤被移出名单，头号射手大卫整季仅 6 个意甲进球、状态低迷。
key_reasons.en: Canada enter depleted: captain Davies (hamstring) is doubtful for the opener, centre-back Bombito has reportedly been removed from the roster through injury, and top striker David scored just 6 Serie A goals all season.

key_reasons.cn: 瑞士核心阵容完整：亚卡任队长、阿坎吉刚随国米夺意甲冠军、科贝尔镇守球门，无关键缺阵，与加拿大的伤情形成不对称。
key_reasons.en: Switzerland's core is intact: Xhaka captains, Akanji arrives fresh off a Serie A title, Kobel in goal, no key absences — an asymmetry against Canada's injury situation.

entries.method_note: Pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (100,000 full-tournament sims, seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, +100 Elo host bonus in group games only, no market input), then a bounded evidence-based adjustment of at most ±4pp per team (Canada −4pp injury cluster, Switzerland +3pp intact squad, Bosnia +1pp opener vs depleted Canada, Qatar 0), renormalized to sum 1.

entries.question_cn: 2026 FIFA 世界杯 C 组头名（最终积分榜第 1）会是哪支球队？
entries.question_en: Which team will finish first in Group C at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
entries.one_liner_cn: 巴西 Elo 断层领先、约七成概率拿下 C 组头名，但多人伤缺加内马尔存疑，摩洛哥与阵容完整的苏格兰合计仍有约三成机会。
entries.one_liner_en: Brazil's big Elo edge makes them roughly 70% to top Group C, but with several injuries and Neymar doubtful, Morocco and a fully fit Scotland together keep about a 30% chance.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 断层：巴西 1991（世界第 5）领先摩洛哥 1827、苏格兰 1782，10 万次纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛模拟中 72.8% 拿下小组头名。
key_reasons.en: Elo gap: Brazil 1991 (world #5) vs Morocco 1827 and Scotland 1782; Brazil tops the group in 72.8% of 100k pure-Elo Monte Carlo simulations.

key_reasons.cn: 巴西阵容扰动：罗德里戈（ACL）与埃斯特旺伤缺、右后卫 Wesley 赛前伤退，内马尔 5 月底小腿伤使首战存疑——下调 2pp 转给阵容完整的苏格兰。
key_reasons.en: Brazil squad disruption: Rodrygo (ACL) and Estevao out, right-back Wesley withdrawn injured pre-tournament, and Neymar's late-May calf injury leaves the opener in doubt — 2pp moved to a fully fit Scotland.

key_reasons.cn: 摩洛哥自身减员（阿格尔德、埃扎祖利赛前因伤退出，恩内斯里落选）抵消了巴西削弱带来的相对利好，维持基线不动。
key_reasons.en: Morocco's own losses (Aguerd and Ezzalzouli withdrew injured pre-tournament; En-Nesyri left out) offset the relative gain from Brazil's weakening, so Morocco stays at baseline.

entries.method_note: Baseline: 100k-sim pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11), no market input. Bounded evidence adjustment within ±4pp/team: Brazil -2pp (injury disruption), Scotland +2pp (intact squad), Morocco and Haiti unchanged (Morocco's own withdrawals offset Brazil's weakening); zero-sum transfer, probabilities sum to 1. Market-blind throughout.

entries.question_cn: D 组头名（小组第一出线）是哪支球队？
entries.question_en: Which team finishes first in Group D?
entries.one_liner_cn: Elo 全组最高的土耳其约五成概率拿下 D 组头名；东道主美国虽有主场加成，但 Cardoso、Agyemang 伤缺令其与巴拉圭的第二名之争更胶着。
entries.one_liner_en: Türkiye, holding the group's highest Elo, has roughly a 50% chance of topping Group D; hosts USA enjoy home advantage but the injury absences of Cardoso and Agyemang tighten their race with Paraguay for second.

key_reasons.cn: 土耳其 Elo 1911（世界第 13）为全组最高，比第二高的巴拉圭（1834）高 77 分，比澳大利亚（1777）和美国（1726）优势更大；纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛基线即给出 49.2% 的头名概率。
key_reasons.en: Türkiye's Elo of 1911 (world #13) is the group's highest — 77 points above second-ranked Paraguay (1834) and further clear of Australia (1777) and USA (1726); the pure-Elo Monte Carlo baseline alone gives them a 49.2% group-winner probability.

key_reasons.cn: 美国三场小组赛全部在本土（模型已含小组赛 +100 Elo 主场加成），但主力后腰 Johnny Cardoso 与前锋 Patrick Agyemang 因伤无缘世界杯，故对美国基线下调 2 个百分点。
key_reasons.en: USA play all three group games at home (the model already includes a +100 Elo host bonus in group play), but starting midfielder Johnny Cardoso and forward Patrick Agyemang miss the tournament through injury, so the USA baseline is shaded down by 2pp.

key_reasons.cn: 土耳其 6 月 2 日公布的 26 人名单以 Güler、Yıldız 为核心且无重大伤病消息，阵容完整度支持其维持模型基线。
key_reasons.en: Türkiye's 26-man squad announced on June 2, built around Güler and Yıldız, carries no major injury news — full squad availability supports keeping them at the model baseline.

entries.method_note: Pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo, 100,000 full-tournament simulations (seed 20260611), eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, +100 Elo host bonus for USA in group matches only, no market input. Single bounded adjustment: USA -2pp for confirmed injury absences (Cardoso, Agyemang), other teams renormalized proportionally to sum to 1.

entries.question_cn: E 组头名（小组第一出线）是哪支球队？
entries.question_en: Which team finishes first in Group E?
entries.one_liner_cn: 德国与厄瓜多尔基本五五开（Elo 仅差 6 分），但厄瓜多尔进攻乏力在净胜球比拼上吃亏，德国以约 49.7% 对 46.1% 微弱领先。
entries.one_liner_en: Germany and Ecuador are essentially a coin flip (6 Elo points apart), but Ecuador's anemic attack is a goal-difference-tiebreak liability, giving Germany a slim 49.7% vs 46.1% edge.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 几乎持平：厄瓜多尔 1938（世界第 9）vs 德国 1932（世界第 10），100k 次纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛给出 49.6% 对 46.7% 的接近五五开基线。
key_reasons.en: Near-identical Elo: Ecuador 1938 (#9) vs Germany 1932 (#10); the 100k pure-Elo Monte Carlo baseline is a 49.6% vs 46.7% near coin flip.

key_reasons.cn: 厄瓜多尔防守极强但进攻乏力：预选赛 18 场仅进 14 球、8 场平局全部 0-0（失 5 球为南美最少）——小组头名常由净胜球决定，此画像对其不利。
key_reasons.en: Ecuador's elite-defense/anemic-attack profile: only 14 goals in 18 qualifiers and all eight draws finished 0-0 (5 conceded, best in CONMEBOL) — a liability when first place hinges on goal difference.

key_reasons.cn: 德国阵容基本齐整：Musiala 已从 2025 年 7 月腿部骨折中恢复，Neuer 小腿伤预计赶上 6-14 揭幕战，仅余轻微节奏/健康问号。
key_reasons.en: Germany's squad is essentially intact: Musiala has recovered from his July 2025 broken leg and Neuer is expected fit for the June 14 opener, leaving only mild rhythm/fitness question marks.

entries.method_note: Baseline: 100k-sim pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, lambda = 2.6 x Elo expectancy, no market input). Bounded evidence adjustment within ±4pp/team: Germany +3.0pp, Ecuador -3.5pp, Ivory Coast +0.5pp for Ecuador's low-scoring style (goal-difference tiebreak liability) partially offset by Germany's mild fitness questions; renormalized to sum 1.

entries.question_cn: F 组头名（小组第一出线）是哪支球队？
entries.question_en: Which team finishes first in Group F?
entries.one_liner_cn: 荷兰凭 Elo 第 8 的实力底盘和更厚的阵容深度约 54% 概率拿下 F 组头名，日本因三笘薫整届缺阵攻击力受损（约 38%），6 月 14 日荷日直接对话基本决定组头归属。
entries.one_liner_en: Netherlands' Elo-No.8 strength base and deeper squad make them about 54% to top Group F; Japan (~38%) lose punch with Mitoma out for the tournament, and the June 14 head-to-head largely decides first place.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 实力分层清晰：荷兰 1948（第 8）、日本 1906（第 14），瑞典 1712、突尼斯 1628 与两强差距 194 分以上，纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛给荷兰 55.9%、日本 39.1% 的基线。
key_reasons.en: Clear Elo stratification: Netherlands 1948 (rank 8) and Japan 1906 (rank 14), with Sweden 1712 and Tunisia 1628 at least 194 points behind the favourites; the pure-Elo Monte Carlo baseline is 55.9% Netherlands, 39.1% Japan.

key_reasons.cn: 日本头号边路爆点三笘薫因腘绳肌伤势落选整届世界杯（森保一称'重大打击'），南野拓実 ACL 同样缺席，直接削弱日本三场小组赛的进攻上限。
key_reasons.en: Japan's top winger Kaoru Mitoma misses the entire World Cup with a hamstring injury (coach Moriyasu: 'a huge blow') and Takumi Minamino is out with an ACL tear, directly capping Japan's attack across all three group games.

key_reasons.cn: 荷兰自身减员面也不小：西蒙斯、斯豪滕（ACL）缺席，廷贝尔退出名单由海尔特雷达替补，门将费尔布鲁根能否赶上 6 月 14 日揭幕战存疑——这限制了荷兰对日本的优势幅度，并把少量概率外溢给瑞典/突尼斯。
key_reasons.en: The Dutch carry their own absences: Xavi Simons and Jerdy Schouten (ACL) are out, Jurrien Timber withdrew with Geertruida called up, and keeper Verbruggen is a doubt for the June 14 opener — narrowing their edge over Japan and leaking a little probability to Sweden/Tunisia.

entries.method_note: Baseline: 100k full-tournament pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, no market input; Elo logistic expectancy splits a 2.6-goal Poisson baseline, FIFA group tiebreakers, no host in Group F). Bounded evidence adjustment within ±4pp/team: NLD −1.5pp, JPN −1.0pp, SWE +2.0pp, TUN +0.5pp; renormalized to sum 1. Source dates marked 2026-06-11 are retrieval dates.

entries.question_cn: G 组头名（小组第一出线）是哪支球队？
entries.question_en: Which team finishes first in Group G?
entries.one_liner_cn: 比利时凭明显的 Elo 实力差距最有可能拿下 G 组头名（约 65%），但核心球员伤病隐患让伊朗（约 24%）保留掀翻的空间。
entries.one_liner_en: Belgium's clear Elo edge makes it the most likely Group G winner (~65%), but fitness doubts over its core leave Iran (~24%) genuine room for an upset.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 断层：比利时 1894（世界第 15）领先伊朗 1772、埃及 1696、新西兰 1562，纯 Elo 十万次模拟给出 67.7% 的头名基线。
key_reasons.en: Elo gap: Belgium 1894 (world #15) vs Iran 1772, Egypt 1696, New Zealand 1562 — the pure-Elo 100k-sim baseline puts Belgium at 67.7% to top the group.

key_reasons.cn: 比利时核心带伤：卢卡库本赛季因反复肌肉伤势几乎没踢正式比赛，德布劳内赛季末因眼伤缺阵，库尔图瓦刚走出伤病赛季——据此下调比利时 3pp。
key_reasons.en: Belgium's core is banged up: Lukaku has played barely an hour of competitive club football this season, De Bruyne was sidelined with an eye injury late in the season, and Courtois is off an injury-disrupted run — basis for the −3pp on Belgium.

key_reasons.cn: 挑战者阵容完整：伊朗 6/1 按期定名单、备战完整，是 6/21 直接对话的最大受益方（+1.5pp）；埃及由萨拉赫领衔、搭档马尔穆什，锋线质量高于其 Elo 排名（+1.5pp）。
key_reasons.en: Challengers intact: Iran named its final squad on schedule (Jun 1) and benefits most from the Jun 21 head-to-head (+1.5pp); Egypt, captained by Salah alongside Marmoush, carries more attacking quality than its Elo rank implies (+1.5pp).

entries.method_note: Pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo, 100,000 full-tournament simulations (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, no market input), plus bounded evidence-based adjustment capped at ±4pp/team: Belgium −3.0pp (core fitness risk), Iran +1.5pp, Egypt +1.5pp; deltas net to zero so the distribution sums to 1. Market-blind throughout.

entries.question_cn: 2026 世界杯 H 组头名（FIFA 最终积分榜第 1）会是哪支球队？（西班牙 / 乌拉圭 / 沙特阿拉伯 / 佛得角）
entries.question_en: Which team will win Group H (first place in the final FIFA standings) at the 2026 World Cup? (Spain / Uruguay / Saudi Arabia / Cape Verde)
entries.one_liner_cn: 西班牙以 Elo 世界第一的实力大概率拿下 H 组头名（约 84%），乌拉圭是唯一现实的挑战者；沙特与佛得角夺组头名基本只是数学上的可能。
entries.one_liner_en: Spain, the world's No. 1 Elo side, is the heavy model favorite to top Group H (~84%); Uruguay is the only realistic challenger, with Saudi Arabia and Cape Verde left as mathematical possibilities.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距悬殊：西班牙 2157（世界第 1）对乌拉圭 1892（第 16）、沙特 1576、佛得角 1578，10 万次纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛模拟给出西班牙 86.2% 的头名基线。
key_reasons.en: Massive Elo gap: Spain 2157 (world No. 1) vs Uruguay 1892 (No. 16), Saudi Arabia 1576 and Cape Verde 1578; the 100k-run pure-Elo Monte Carlo gives Spain an 86.2% baseline to top the group.

key_reasons.cn: 西班牙带伤进入小组赛：亚马尔腿筋伤可能缺席前 1-2 场、费尔明·洛佩斯骨折退出，构成小幅下调（−2pp）的依据，但主帅称首战基本全员可用。
key_reasons.en: Spain enter the group stage with knocks: Lamine Yamal's hamstring may cost the first one or two games and Fermin Lopez is out with a fracture, grounds for a small -2pp adjustment, though the coach expects near-full availability from game one.

key_reasons.cn: 乌拉圭是唯一现实挑战者但状态不佳：热身近 4 场不胜（含 1-5 负美国），夺头名几乎必须 6/27 直接击败西班牙，因此上调幅度有限（+1.8pp）。
key_reasons.en: Uruguay are the only realistic challenger but in poor form: winless in their last four (including 1-5 vs USA), and topping the group all but requires beating Spain on Jun 27, so the upward adjustment is capped (+1.8pp).

entries.method_note: Pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo, 100,000 full-tournament simulations (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, no market input), group ranking by points/GD/goals/head-to-head/random; plus bounded evidence-based adjustment capped at +/-4pp per team (Spain -2.0pp injury risk, Uruguay +1.8pp, Saudi Arabia/Cape Verde +0.1pp each), renormalized to sum 1.

entries.question_cn: I 组头名（小组第一出线）是哪支球队？
entries.question_en: Which team finishes first in Group I?
entries.one_liner_cn: 法国阵容齐整且 Elo 高出挪威约 150 分，约 72% 概率拿下 I 组头名；挪威有哈兰德但厄德高伤情存疑，塞内加尔是第三选项。
entries.one_liner_en: A full-strength France, ~150 Elo points above Norway, win Group I in about 72% of simulations; Norway have an in-form Haaland but Odegaard's fitness is in doubt, with Senegal a distant third option.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 断层：法国 2063（世界第 3）对挪威 1914（第 11）、塞内加尔 1860（第 21）、伊拉克 1607（第 63），10 万次纯 Elo 模拟给出法国 70.4% 的头名基线。
key_reasons.en: Elo gap: France 2063 (world No. 3) vs Norway 1914 (No. 11), Senegal 1860 (No. 21), Iraq 1607 (No. 63); the 100k pure-Elo simulation gives France a 70.4% group-winner baseline.

key_reasons.cn: 法国满员出战：姆巴佩伤愈入选并出任队长，德尚明确排除萨利巴伤情疑虑，无停赛或伤病危机。
key_reasons.en: France at full strength: Mbappe recovered and named captain, Deschamps dismissed Saliba fitness fears; no suspension or injury crisis.

key_reasons.cn: 挪威核心隐患：哈兰德确认出战且状态火热（预选赛 16 球），但厄德高本季至少 5 次伤停、缺席 3 月友谊赛，组织端高度依赖其健康——挪威基线下调 2pp。
key_reasons.en: Norway's core risk: Haaland is confirmed fit and in form (16 qualifying goals), but Odegaard suffered at least five injuries this season and missed the March friendlies; creativity hinges on his health — Norway adjusted down 2pp.

entries.method_note: Baseline: 100,000 full-tournament pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo simulations (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, no market input). Bounded evidence adjustment: Norway -2pp for Odegaard fitness uncertainty (cited), redistributed proportionally to the other teams and renormalized to sum 1; all per-team deltas within +/-4pp.

entries.question_cn: J 组头名（小组赛最终积分榜第一）是哪支球队？
entries.question_en: Which team finishes first in Group J?
entries.one_liner_cn: 阿根廷以世界第二的 Elo 碾压同组三队，梅西伤愈进入名单，而奥地利核心鲍姆加特纳伤退——约九成概率头名出线。
entries.one_liner_en: Argentina's world-No.2 Elo towers over the group, Messi is fit and in the squad, and Austria has lost Baumgartner — roughly a nine-in-ten chance to top Group J.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距悬殊：阿根廷 2115（世界第 2），领先组内第二的奥地利（1830）285 分；10 万次纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛模拟中阿根廷 87.9% 拿下小组头名。
key_reasons.en: Massive Elo gap: Argentina 2115 (world #2), 285 points clear of Austria (1830), the group's next best; Argentina tops the group in 87.9% of 100k pure-Elo Monte Carlo simulations.

key_reasons.cn: 阿根廷无人员危机：梅西 5 月底腿筋不适后已伤愈复出，热身赛对冰岛进球，正常进入 26 人名单。
key_reasons.en: No Argentina availability crisis: Messi recovered from his late-May hamstring issue, scored in the final friendly vs Iceland, and is in the 26-man squad.

key_reasons.cn: 最大挑战者被削弱：奥地利核心进攻中场鲍姆加特纳大腿拉伤，确认缺席整届世界杯且不递补（调整 −2pp）。
key_reasons.en: Top challenger weakened: Austria's key attacking midfielder Baumgartner is out of the entire tournament with a thigh injury and no replacement was called up (−2pp adjustment).

entries.method_note: Baseline: 100k-sim pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, no market input). Bounded evidence adjustment: Austria −2.0pp for Baumgartner ruled out (no replacement), renormalized to sum 1; all deltas within ±4pp. Market-blind: no betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: K 组头名（小组赛最终积分榜第一）是哪支球队？
entries.question_en: Which team finishes first in Group K?
entries.one_liner_cn: 葡萄牙与哥伦比亚 Elo 仅差 7 分、头名之争几乎五五开且两队均满员出战，归属大概率取决于迈阿密直接对话；乌兹别克斯坦与刚果（金）争头名机会渺茫。
entries.one_liner_en: Portugal and Colombia sit just 7 Elo points apart in a near coin-flip for top spot with both squads fully fit, so first place likely comes down to their head-to-head in Miami; Uzbekistan and DR Congo are long shots.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 几乎持平：葡萄牙 1989（世界第 6）对哥伦比亚 1982（世界第 7）仅差 7 分，10 万次纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛模拟给出 50.2% vs 47.1% 的五五开格局；后两队（乌兹别克斯坦 1714、刚果（金）1652）差距均超 260 分。
key_reasons.en: Elo virtually level: Portugal 1989 (world #6) vs Colombia 1982 (world #7), a 7-point gap; 100k pure-Elo Monte Carlo simulations yield a 50.2% vs 47.1% coin-flip, with the bottom two (Uzbekistan 1714, Congo DR 1652) more than 260 points adrift.

key_reasons.cn: 葡萄牙无人员危机：C 罗 3 月肌肉伤已痊愈，5 月 19 日入选马丁内斯的世界杯名单，并在 6 月 10 日对尼日利亚的热身赛首发，将出战个人第六届世界杯。
key_reasons.en: No Portugal availability crisis: Ronaldo recovered from his March muscle injury, was named in Martinez's World Cup squad on 19 May, and started the 10 June friendly against Nigeria ahead of his sixth World Cup.

key_reasons.cn: 哥伦比亚阵容完整：J 罗与迪亚斯（拜仁、队内射手王）领衔 26 人名单，J 罗集训期间的轻微不适已恢复，无实质减员——因此本次不做任何概率调整（0pp）。
key_reasons.en: Colombia's squad is intact: James Rodriguez and Luis Diaz (Bayern, top scorer) headline the 26-man roster, and James's minor training-camp knock has cleared — hence zero probability adjustment (0pp) this run.

entries.method_note: Baseline: 100k-sim pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, no market input). Bounded evidence adjustment: 0pp — two targeted availability searches (Portugal, Colombia) found no material absences, so final probabilities equal the baseline; all deltas within ±4pp. Market-blind: no betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: L 组头名（小组赛最终积分榜第一）是哪支球队？
entries.question_en: Which team finishes first in Group L?
entries.one_liner_cn: 英格兰 Elo 领先克罗地亚 112 分且名单齐整，6/17 揭幕战直接对话定走向，约七成概率拿下 L 组头名；莫德里奇术后状态存疑令克罗地亚小幅下调。
entries.one_liner_en: England lead Croatia by 112 Elo points with a full-strength squad, and the June 17 head-to-head opener decides the group — roughly a 70% chance to finish first; Modric's post-surgery fitness doubt slightly downgrades Croatia.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距明确：英格兰 2024（世界第 4）领先克罗地亚 1912（#12）112 分，巴拿马 1730、加纳 1510 差距悬殊；10 万次纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛模拟中英格兰 68.4% 拿下小组头名。
key_reasons.en: Clear Elo gap: England 2024 (world #4) lead Croatia 1912 (#12) by 112 points, with Panama 1730 and Ghana 1510 far behind; England top the group in 68.4% of 100k pure-Elo Monte Carlo simulations.

key_reasons.cn: 英格兰无人员危机：图赫尔 5/22 公布 26 人名单，凯恩任队长、贝林厄姆在列，无重大伤停。
key_reasons.en: No England availability crisis: Tuchel named the 26-man squad on May 22 with Kane as captain and Bellingham included; no major absences.

key_reasons.cn: 唯一挑战者带伤疑：克罗地亚 40 岁队长莫德里奇 4 月颧骨骨折手术、缺席俱乐部赛季收官，预计赶上 6/17 对英格兰的首战但状态存疑（调整 −1.5pp）。
key_reasons.en: The only challenger carries a fitness doubt: Croatia's 40-year-old captain Modric had cheekbone-fracture surgery in April and missed the end of the club season; he is expected fit for the June 17 opener vs England, but sharpness is uncertain (−1.5pp adjustment).

entries.method_note: Baseline: 100k-sim pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, no market input). Bounded evidence adjustment: Croatia -1.5pp for Modric's post-surgery fitness doubt (in squad, expected fit for the opener), renormalized to sum 1; all deltas within +/-4pp. Market-blind: no betting or prediction-market data used.

entries.question_cn: 哪些球队能晋级 2026 世界杯八强（赢下 16 强淘汰赛、进入 1/4 决赛）？48 队各自的晋级概率（合计约 8）。
entries.question_en: Which teams reach the 2026 World Cup quarter-finals (win their Round-of-16 tie)? Per-team probabilities for all 48 teams (summing to ~8).
entries.one_liner_cn: 最可能的八强是西班牙、阿根廷、法国、英格兰、葡萄牙、巴西、哥伦比亚、荷兰——但没有任何球队超过 75%，48 队扩军让八强名额比以往任何一届都更分散。
entries.one_liner_en: The most likely quarter-final eight are Spain, Argentina, France, England, Portugal, Brazil, Colombia and the Netherlands — yet no team clears 75%, as the 48-team format spreads the eight slots thinner than ever.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 前八（西班牙 2157 至荷兰 1948）恰好是模型给出的八强前八候选，合计拿走 8 个名额中的约 4.3 个；扩军后强队小组更软、16 强多对阵小组第三，头部转化率被进一步抬高。
key_reasons.en: The Elo top eight (Spain 2157 down to Netherlands 1948) are exactly the model’s top eight QF candidates, collectively claiming ~4.3 of the 8 slots; the expanded format gives top seeds softer groups and R32 ties often against third-placed sides.

key_reasons.cn: 豪强之间的伤病不对称是主要调整项：巴西（罗德里戈/米利唐/埃斯特旺缺席、内马尔伤疑）、荷兰（廷贝尔退出）、比利时（德布劳内/卢卡库带伤）下调，全员健康的英格兰上调。
key_reasons.en: Injury asymmetry among contenders drives the adjustments: Brazil (Rodrygo/Militão/Estêvão out, Neymar doubtful), Netherlands (Timber withdrawn) and Belgium (De Bruyne/Lukaku arriving injured) are marked down; a fully fit England is marked up.

key_reasons.cn: 第 9 至 17 位（比利时到克罗地亚）全部挤在 20%–35% 区间：对这批球队而言，小组头名与否（决定 16 强对手档次）比自身实力差异更能左右八强命运。
key_reasons.en: Places 9–17 (Belgium through Croatia) are all packed into the 20%–35% band: for this tier, winning the group (and thus the calibre of the R32 opponent) moves their QF fate more than raw strength differences do.

entries.method_note: Pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (100,000 full-tournament sims, seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, +100 Elo host bonus in group games only, official 2026 bracket with third-place allocation; no market input of any kind), then bounded evidence-based adjustments of at most ±6% relative per team (cap ±20%) for cited injury/fitness news on top-tier squads, renormalized so the 48 probabilities sum to 8.

entries.question_cn: 哪些球队进入 2026 世界杯四强（赢下 1/4 决赛、晋级半决赛，最后 4 队）？
entries.question_en: Which teams reach the semifinals (win their quarterfinal, last 4) at the 2026 World Cup?
entries.one_liner_cn: 最可能的四强是西班牙、阿根廷、法国、英格兰——三支 Elo 2000+ 球队加上签位最顺的英格兰；巴西虽然 Elo 第 5，但伤病减员叠加与英格兰、墨西哥同处一个 1/4 区，四强概率被压到约 22%。
entries.one_liner_en: The most likely final four are Spain, Argentina, France and England — the three Elo 2000+ sides plus the team with the cleanest squad; Brazil, despite ranking 5th on Elo, are squeezed to about 22% by injuries and by sharing a quarter with England and Mexico.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 断层主导：西班牙（2157）、阿根廷（2115）、法国（2063）是仅有的三支 Elo 2000+ 球队，10 万次纯 Elo 蒙特卡洛模拟给出 66%/57%/50% 的四强基线，远超第 4 名英格兰（34%）之后的所有球队。
key_reasons.en: The Elo gap dominates: Spain (2157), Argentina (2115) and France (2063) are the only Elo 2000+ sides, and the 100k-run pure-Elo Monte Carlo gives them 66%/57%/50% semifinal baselines, far ahead of everyone behind 4th-placed England (34%).

key_reasons.cn: 签表结构决定中游命运：按官方淘汰赛对阵，英格兰、巴西、墨西哥的预计路径同处一个 1/4 区（最多一队进四强）；法国、荷兰与 E 组头名（德国/厄瓜多尔）同区；K 组出线者（葡萄牙/哥伦比亚）无论头名还是第二，1/4 决赛前后大概率撞上阿根廷或西班牙。
key_reasons.en: Bracket structure decides the mid-tier: on the official knockout tree, England, Brazil and Mexico project into the same quarter (at most one can reach the last 4); France, the Netherlands and the Group E winner (Germany/Ecuador) share another; and whoever emerges from Group K (Portugal/Colombia) is likely to run into Argentina or Spain around the quarterfinal.

key_reasons.cn: 伤病不对称是主要调整项：巴西（罗德里戈 ACL、内马尔小腿伤疑）、葡萄牙（C 罗 3 个月大腿伤刚复出）、荷兰、日本、比利时等带伤减员被下调（最大 −10% 相对）；英格兰训练营全员健康、哥伦比亚满编且主要对手带伤，获小幅上调。
key_reasons.en: Injury asymmetry drives the adjustments: Brazil (Rodrygo ACL, Neymar calf doubt), Portugal (Ronaldo just back from a three-month thigh injury), the Netherlands, Japan and Belgium were marked down (max -10% relative), while England, with a clean bill of health in camp, and a fully fit Colombia were nudged up.

entries.method_note: 100,000-run pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo over the full official 2026 bracket (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, no market input) + bounded evidence-based adjustments (largest used ±10% relative, cap ±20%), renormalized so the 48 probabilities sum to 4. Market-blind by policy.
